[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59378546/393998099/-171770090?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230227_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDcyMGZkNy1mYWI2LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRYqyuoHditf6mydz3H-Cy7_zmWUxLyOiMClP2xIVKw=) Hello — I wanted you to hear directly from me: **I am running for the United States Senate in Michigan.** I’m going to lay out more on why I’m running, but if you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign right away you can use this link to split a donation between our campaign and Jason Crow: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-slotkin](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59378552/393998107/-171770090?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230227_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDcyMGZkNy1mYWI2LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRYqyuoHditf6mydz3H-Cy7_zmWUxLyOiMClP2xIVKw=)** | [SPLIT A DONATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59378561/393998114/-171770090?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230227_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDcyMGZkNy1mYWI2LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRYqyuoHditf6mydz3H-Cy7_zmWUxLyOiMClP2xIVKw=)

So here’s why I’ve decided to run: we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be _really_ simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets that _we are public servants._
Because service is how I’ve spent my life: I spent my career protecting our homeland. After 9/11, I was recruited into the CIA and served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military. I went on to serve under Presidents of both parties in the White House, and then at the Pentagon.
But what motivated me to first run for elected office was my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 – and she didn’t have health insurance. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience – of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork – helped shape my decision to run for office.
These experiences have shaped my time, my priorities, my approach to my four years in the U.S. House, and continue to serve as my motivation to run for Senate.
My experience also impacts how I’ve run my campaigns. Before my first run in 2018, I made a decision to not accept any donations from corporate PACs, because I never wanted my constituents to question why I vote the way I do.
**My campaign for the U.S. Senate will also refuse money from corporate PACs. Not a dime.**
Some people might see it as a disadvantage, especially since Senate campaigns are notoriously expensive. But I know that we can win when we’re powered by real people, contributing what they can, when they can.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. It’s also going to take a lot of work – which is why I’ll be hitting the ground to kick off a listening tour through Michigan, starting with Detroit later this week, to hear what people throughout the state want from their leaders.
When you’re running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, we need to start building our war chest on day one. That’s why I’m hoping you’ll be moved to support this campaign today.
**I would be honored if you would split a contribution between our campaign and Jason Crow today and become one of our first Founding Donors.**

clean_body: | = Hello — I wanted you to hear directly from me: I am running for the United States Senate in Michigan. I’m going to lay out more on why I’m running, but if you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign right away you can use this link to split a donation between our campaign and Jason Crow: = | = So here’s why I’ve decided to run: we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple: Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class. Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security. Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them. And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream. I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets that we are public servants. Because service is how I’ve spent my life: I spent my career protecting our homeland. After 9/11, I was recruited into the CIA and served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military. I went on to serve under Presidents of both parties in the White House, and then at the Pentagon. But what motivated me to first run for elected office was my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 – and she didn’t have health insurance. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience – of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork – helped shape my decision to run for office. These experiences have shaped my time, my priorities, my approach to my four years in the U.S. House, and continue to serve as my motivation to run for Senate. My experience also impacts how I’ve run my campaigns. Before my first run in 2018, I made a decision to not accept any donations from corporate PACs, because I never wanted my constituents to question why I vote the way I do. My campaign for the U.S. Senate will also refuse money from corporate PACs. Not a dime. Some people might see it as a disadvantage, especially since Senate campaigns are notoriously expensive. But I know that we can win when we’re powered by real people, contributing what they can, when they can. To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. It’s also going to take a lot of work – which is why I’ll be hitting the ground to kick off a listening tour through Michigan, starting with Detroit later this week, to hear what people throughout the state want from their leaders. When you’re running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, we need to start building our war chest on day one. That’s why I’m hoping you’ll be moved to support this campaign today. I would be honored if you would split a contribution between our campaign and Jason Crow today and become one of our first Founding Donors. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jason Crow and Elissa Slotkin will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = I know that our country is going to get through this time. It’s hard work, but that's what Michiganders have done for generations. It’s going to take engaged citizens and principled leaders. I’m grateful to know we’re in this together from the start. Thank you in advance for chipping in. Onward! body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59379027/394000902/1282154877?refcode=EM_FR_230227JT_N_JT_FULL_8_G_B_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYTc1YzE4Ni1mYmI2LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1EW3TJ4SMgp0s79V_UWLbTF-9q9HCkgBejj2-QO8cS0=) Can I explain something, folks?

I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat-grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.

In fact, I’m very proud to be the only U.S. Senator who manages a full-time job outside the Senate — **as a farmer.**

Every spring, I spend weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

Dear Friends and Supporters, I’m reaching out today to once again offer my sincerest gratitude for your support of my 2022... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4fb75613986e/update-from-james-judge-on-whats-next?e=00028e5542)

Dear Friends and Supporters,
I’m reaching out today to once again offer my sincerest gratitude for your support of my 2022 Congressional campaign against Rep. Kathy Castor (D-FL).
While we came up short in the general election, our campaign was a massive success. In fact, we came closer to beating Castor than anyone who had previously run against her. We won on Election Day, and we won in Early Voting, despite more Democrats turning out than Republicans. Somehow the trends didn’t follow with the mail votes, but that’s the in past.
While at this point, I’m unsure of what the future holds in terms of running for political office again, I still believe strongly in the importance of spreading Christian, conservative values.
[**That’s why I’m not going to stop fighting**.](https://factsinpolitics.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=4193d515b6&e=00028e5542)
Today, I’m announcing the launch of FACTS in Politics – and you, the loyal supporters of my congressional campaign – are the first to know about it.
FACTS in Politics is America’s newest conservative Political Action Committee, focused on ensuring that lies are exposed, and the truth is spread.
Our effort will be to ensure that so-called “facts” espoused by politicians and the media are evaluated against Biblical truths.
Beyond exposing lies, we’ll work hard to help God-fearing, conservative leaders get elected to office.
For too long, politicians, and the media who work as their activists, have **lied, gaslit and manipulated the American people**.
To counter those efforts, we plan to fact check the “fact checkers,” and set the record straight.
Soon, we plan to launch a nationwide billboard and digital messaging campaign highlighting simple truths.
Some of those truths include:
· Transgenderism is mental illness.· Pride is a sin.· Jesus was killed for telling the truth.· Porn is destroying our country.· George Floyd was a criminal.· Concerned parents are not domestic terrorists.
Since you so graciously supported me during my campaign, I’m asking you to step up to the plate again today.
[**By contributing to FACTS in Politics today, you are helping me continue to forward the conservative movement in the United States**](https://factsinpolitics.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=ff6e296da5&e=00028e5542).
[**I need your support today to help get this PAC off the ground, so we can bring truth back to politics**](https://factsinpolitics.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=97b7fc9bc5&e=00028e5542).
[**Please chip in what you can – whether it’s $10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more – and support me as I continue to fight for conservative values**](https://factsinpolitics.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=f2531cffc9&e=00028e5542).
If you’re able, please consider giving a recurring monthly donation to help as we move forward.
Thank you in advance for your generous contributions.
Sincerely,
James Judge

Peter — See that little girl in the photo? That’s me, with my Nana and grandfather. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59380769/394025978/-1998320847?refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20230227_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Njk1MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzVjOWNiNi0wM2I3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UAejaNXqrZvzezJwsJE4c5I79DDn_AYYWRFxI5mZpV8=) They raised me right here in Wisconsin and worked hard to give me every opportunity in the world to learn, grow, and thrive. And when they got older, I became my Nana’s primary caregiver. It was a challenging but deeply rewarding experience — one that continues to inform my work as a Senator. I saw firsthand the importance of strengthening and protecting Wisconsinites’ earned benefits of Medicare and Social Security. **That’s why I’m appalled that Republicans are threatening budget cuts to these vital programs.** As a Senator, I’ve worked across party lines to pass bipartisan legislation into law to support family caregivers across America. I’m committed to protecting and expanding affordable healthcare access for all people and will fight any effort to end Social Security and Medicare. Seniors have worked too hard to see these programs taken away by Republicans. **[I’m defending these programs from Republican attacks in the U.S. Senate, and I’m hoping you can chip in a few dollars before my February fundraising deadline to make sure I can keep up the fight. **_Original Message from Jimmy Panetta:_**

Peter,

As we begin the 118th Congress in the new 19th Congressional District of California, I’ve been busy.

Here’s just an example of a few things that I’ve done in the past couple of weeks:
* Continued to ensure that the federal government plays its part in our local storm recovery efforts so FEMA, SBA, USDA, and other federal relief agencies follow through with assistance

* Put pressure on FEMA for their approval of backlogged reimbursements in their wildfire disaster response in the new part of my congressional district

* Secured $1 million in federal funding to establish wellness centers at our local public schools to increase our mental health services for our youth

* Secured $1.16 million in federal funding local police to deploy technology to help them gather intelligence, fight crime, and increase our public safety

* Secured $30 million in federal funding to expand Highway One between Watsonville and Santa Cruz to reduce traffic and our carbon output and increase our pedestrian and bike safety

* Secured $900,000 in federal funding to prevent roadway deaths, improve pedestrian, and cyclist safety

* Secured $500,000 in federal funding for ocean and climate research in Monterey Bay

* Held numerous town halls throughout the new parts of my congressional district to hear from new constituents

* Held office hours in the new parts of my congressional district to personally meet with new constituents

* Attended Farm Bill Listening Session to promote agricultural trade and increase global competitiveness for California farmers

* Relaunched the congressional caucus to eliminate the arbitrary cap on the harmful State and Local Tax deduction

* Reintroduced the Broadband Grant Tax Treatment Act to exempt small businesses from taxes on federal funding to deploy and expand broadband access

* Reintroduced my bipartisan, bicameral bill to honor Vietnam War POW Everett Alvarez, Jr. with the Congressional Gold Medal

As the U.S. Representative for the 19th Congressional District, it is my responsibility to deliver for our communities.

However, even while I serve my constituents, I must continue to ask for your support for my upcoming re-election campaign.

My end-of-month fundraising deadline is just around the corner and I wanted to ask if you could donate whatever you can to help us hit our fundraising goal.

body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv. ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

In an interview published in _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court Clarence Thomas explained what he sees as his role on the nation's highest court: **" My job is to apply the Constitution."**

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi5rgo8stbc0k9b32el1b88377t6k6kq92ncme2o_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clge4o36clh2bs) [NO](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zprun8c4a14g1spq2qngh94gp9of4glne4vu45ug_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clge4o36clh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv5pbvlkbkbm133di3349k2ud1fo8r053003hdhg_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clge4o36clh2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty--featuring issues such as "Clarence Thomas and the Lost Constitution."

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zumfnk7soc3f29ra4aojiehtqgi4agos3611l8l8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clge4o36clh2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

name: Your America
subject: Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy?
body:
Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system.

| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. ](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c08110%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kbwGNoefDLw2%2fZDZrEFsMw&sysid=1) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she’s discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I’ve found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ our economy into something we didn’t vote on ... didn’t ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we’re about to see a stranger, more extreme ‘new normal’ in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead.”** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there’s no cost to watch. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ could affect you - and find out what it means for your money.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c08111%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F3ZbvtQSmERbFN6VF057QA&sysid=1) [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c08112%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5hmix0mpfVaR3CBPMz6Wsw&sysid=1)

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651572%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RpQMdWAa%2fiAzvD%2bPrV7gtA&sysid=1)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty--featuring issues such as “Clarence Thomas and the Lost Constitution.”

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

name: Candace Owens
subject: The dark side of Black History Month
body:
Black History Month isn't about celebrating the Black men and women who've changed the world for the better.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6vf1o1lev5sdrk17qk401vuhpq5nj2meuag9pvo_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clgeepj2c3h2bs)

Friend,

It's Black History Month. . . The month when a bunch of people who know nothing about black history take the time to celebrate people like Frederick Douglas -- but have never read any of his works.

Black History Month isn't about celebrating the Black men and women who've changed the world for the better.

It's nothing more than a way for woke radicals to push identity politics and glorify division in America.

I don't want a Black History Month, and I can't say "why" better than Morgan Freeman did:

_" You're going to relegate my history to a month? **Black history is American history.** "_

My name is Candace Owens, and I am a co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. One of the reasons I helped found BLEXIT was to teach REAL history to Black and minority communities.

To teach true American history -- _and not the socialist, woke version that 's pushed today_ -- I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month.

[_**Will you join me in the push for TRUE history, Friend, by sending a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to show your support >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn6v3lqq0ht7l9oajlk7spa9u2m2j763b3lbo1u8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clgeepj2c3h2bs)

BLEXIT honors independent black voices like. . .

. . . Thomas Sowell, a well-known American conservative and is considered one of the most influential black conservatives who has authored over 40 books.

. . . Clarence Thomas, a Constitutional originalist and Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States.

. . . Walter Williams, an American economist, commentator, author, and academic and former John M. Olin Distinguished Professor of Economics at George Mason University.

That's why I hope you'll join me in our effort to celebrate Black Excellence and work to build a better future for Black and minority communities. [_**Click here to send a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zudcoodg877o3g61q9ao992sfi7vqsqv09nbglv8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clgeepj2c3h2bs)

Here's how we're reaching Black and minority communities with American history:

**BLEXIT 's Liberation Camps** provide an American History curriculum to children in Kindergarten through 8th grade who live in low-income communities. We also teach key life skills and character development.

The children experience 18 weeks of after-school programming, six weeks of full-day summer camp programming, 25 full-day programs when schools had in-service days, and 20 parents-night-out programs and field trips.

**And through our 43 State Chapters made up of more than 14,000 volunteers! **

Our chapter members bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.
1. **Advocating** for School Choice.
2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.
3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.

Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

BLEXIT State Chapter members work within their local communities to help change the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy?
body:
Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system.

| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5arjf7eftpm53vk8os8dnrii1ttecj5qkco06gg_rp22sh2s8i66pr7clgeepj2cth2bs) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she’s discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. body:
Hi – I’ll explain more below but our (victorious!) campaign has a little bit of debt to pay off. We made some great progress before the end of the year, and we’ve got just a little bit left to go. If you could give just $10 right now -- split with Serve America -- to help us pay it down so that I can continue focusing my energy on serving in the Senate, I’d be very grateful. Here’s the link: secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-hassan [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-hassan]
Look – the last few weeks of our campaign were a whirlwind. GOP spending against us skyrocketed, polls tightened, and pundits were doubting whether we could win.
My team put our heads down and focused on our final advertising investments to get us through the last few days of the campaign. We were making decisions with the information we had, hoping with all our might that the funding will come through.
Unfortunately, all of our funding didn’t come through and now my campaign has a bit of a hole to fill to get our last bills paid. We’ve made a ton of progress in closing the gap and since you’re one of my most important supporters, I’m hoping that I can count on you to get us over the top.
Will you please give $10 or as much as you can to help us retire our debt? Your donation will be split between my campaign and Serve America, and I’d be grateful for anything you can give. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-hassan]
I’m proud of you and our campaign team and the work we did together. Now, we just have to finish this thing off.
Thank you for your help.
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

name: Conservatives Give
subject: Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy?
body:
Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system.

| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to 'Transform' the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db92aaaf33d3412d9397d06e0061a181&_e=qenDzHV9zvFSMtmfVk9bIZiALgHe2homUF5elLXDPa74RLJtb2UNgNm-HIISx3Nh5XzGNXc64vasb5RyAU-LgiF-bF7bYzzbywUzhkXnaWd_r7bp242ifg6ckTFsauTG4E1bDw1_LlE3cUMu37KuS8S3A5sqAOLAnS9gVynk_WmW8MFhz7mGeIiSjNea8gCOMAj-AYlKU__hLYBQH8mWV3sFEa1zOtWmfiB6YU05BhIGPTzDvHjcbjIBItOcH9Zo) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this 'transformation' as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their 'transformation'? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she's discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **" While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I've found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to 'transform' our economy into something we didn't vote on... didn't ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we 're about to see a stranger, more extreme 'new normal' in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead. "** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there's no cost to watch. [Go here to see how this 'transformation' could affect you - and find out what it means for your money.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db92aaaf33d3412d9397d06e0061a181&_e=qenDzHV9zvFSMtmfVk9bIZiALgHe2homUF5elLXDPa74RLJtb2UNgNm-HIISx3Nh5XzGNXc64vasb5RyAU-LgiF-bF7bYzzbywUzhkXnaWdxJUketkpr0TKf6PvrNULkBpxglLT7cfMEmNs6MwohQy90GHa_CYZ9FZi7ybpQ0mMJX1bntmgy33mqZBN7xysYjpwIUAJRD-LXP2QkXp5mvpR-om9YZXNfE7Z2Mvf4F5W_TkVPbjHO2zKKBdRwP7V_) [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db92aaaf33d3412d9397d06e0061a181&_e=qenDzHV9zvFSMtmfVk9bIZiALgHe2homUF5elLXDPa74RLJtb2UNgNm-HIISx3Nh5XzGNXc64vasb5RyAU-LgiF-bF7bYzzbywUzhkXnaWdiGlyaN5xU3S45izln61OBBuC030jHl_tzFIafW6d8S3ncm-yFz7dffDgeCtz2BtC21RsVi0LFFwDBI1Eum1Vau_AOydtXKmmFcCtQbpcnz3r7mBg5S5tJJJqNC0bdoJlCxEZlDlHZzW-6mFz4lNew)

| | | Recently, it was revealed that Kevin McCarthy [secretly leaked over 41,000 hours of highly sensitive U.S. Capitol surveillance footage of the Jan 6 insurrection to Fox News' Tucker Carlson.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T296fe8b3-f393-4cb9-afbe-e6e57bc13723/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It may have been done for political reasons, but this is also** a huge security risk to lawmakers and Capitol staff. The footage reveals the location of security cameras across the Capitol grounds. It tells future attackers how they can make the next attack even worse.** Which raises the question – should Kevin McCarthy face legal charges? He may be Speaker (barely), but does that give him complete immunity from punishment for putting his colleagues' lives at risk? If he had given it to a terrorist group, would he still face no consequences? (arguably, that's exactly what he did). We need a Special Counsel to investigate whether McCarthy should face such charges – and punishment. name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Suing Kaiser Permanente for abusing children
body:
Chloe Cole was just 13 years old when activist doctors decided

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot,Chloe Cole was just 13 years old when activist doctors decidedshe was “trans”... _... and fast-tracked her into Kaiser Permanente’s multi-billion-dollar_ _industry to “transition” her from a girl to a boy._
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkk0g695u7g19k7pdk6otijhbpsm7v6fe6kn6gro_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg6cpj1clh2bs)
---
| |
* She was given weekly testosterone injections.
* She was injected with an experimental drug used to chemically castrate sex offenders.
* And finally, at age 15, the doctors at Kaiser Permanente removed Chloe’s healthy breasts in a radical double mastectomy.

---
| | Chloe and her parents were coerced by these doctors into thinking she was a boy. They purposefully lied to her about the side effects of the experimental treatments they were forcing her under. **And they effectively used Chloe as a lab rat to “test” their “gender affirming care.”** Now for the rest of Chloe’s life, her voice will always be deeper, she’ll never be able to breastfeed – if she can even have children – and who knows what cancers, fertility problems, cardiac problems, bone problems, and more lurk in her future. **Bottom line: The doctors at Kaiser Permanente destroyed Chloe’s healthy body for profit.****And this is happening to children across America.** My non-profit, the Center for American Liberty, is helping Chloe Cole SUE Kaiser Permanente for permanently destroying her body... **...and finally bring justice to those who have suffered the same fate at the hands of doctors they should have been able to trust.**[**I’m asking you to support Chloe’s landmark lawsuit today by contributing a tax-deductible donation of $35 to the case’s legal fund.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zarsofs2tj1almm4edrcggtdkj7rpomns2rle0b8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg6cpj1clh2bs) Winning this case won’t be easy. Kaiser Permanente is the largest medical group in the country.They’re going to come at us with high-powered lawyers to protect their goldmine.**But making radical activists like this pay through litigation is the only way we’ll shut them down.** [**I’m counting on you to join me in Chloe’s fight today by supporting our legal battle with a tax-deductible $35 donation to our legal fund.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfj8i7nhur9kvu1uo02p3pu6g0cpoai29one9718_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg6cpj1clh2bs) Any donation you can send today will get us one step closer to finally bringing Chloe the justice she deserves after being coerced and harmed by a hospital that abused her like a lab rat.

Winning this case won’t be easy. Kaiser Permanente is the largest medical group in the country.They’re going to come at us with high-powered lawyers to protect their goldmine.But making radical activists like this pay through litigation is the only way we’ll shut them down. name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: What does it mean to be an American in 2023?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
If you’re going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding.

| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78037%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nLlEvAL%2bjuYftvEgA9QO%2bA&sysid=1)
Fellow American,

I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

I might have been a skinny kid with a funny last name, but my parents taught me an important lesson: _If you are going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding._

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78038%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=29LGVNc5pDL0FsZybfrRnw&sysid=1)
Today, we're starting a cultural movement in our country, Fellow American, and I want you to be a part of it. I want you to join our movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.

This time it isn't just about money. It is about the unapologetic pursuit of excellence itself. It means that we:

Believe in merit.
Believe in accountability.
Believe in free speech.
Believe in American exceptionalism.
Fellow American, if you're on board with these ideals, then we're already on the same team. We're ready to fight for the future of America. If we rediscover our shared national identity, then we can take on the greatest external threat we face: Communist China.

**[Will you join me? Please take just a few minutes to watch my launch video- and join Team Vivek by chipping in $1 or even $5 today as I launch my presidential campaign.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78039%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hb9248xDyUm6PEya1Yx0lA&sysid=1)**

It's time to stand up to the ruling aristocracy in America - in Washington D.C., on Wall Street, and in Silicon Valley - that does whatever allows them to accumulate more money and power for themselves. They try to divide & conquer, but that won't work if we stay united.

**E pluribus unum - _from many, one._**

These are the ideals that won the American Revolution; that reunited us after the Civil War; that won two World Wars and the Cold War. I believe deep in my bones these ideals still exist, and I am running for President to revive them.

Join me,

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78030%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VfFd7ZmDutGXN%2bdEuHwlFA&sysid=1)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** WATCH NOW →**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78031%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t0pVFLWEi9JI9Lv3WCsG1w&sysid=1)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[ ** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c78032%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aqoP4taMVawVtmeAsHULTQ&sysid=1)

Friend,
**Today, the Supreme Court is hearing oral arguments about President Biden’s student loan forgiveness plan to cancel up to $20,000 in debt.**
We’ve been in the trenches of the fight for student debt relief, one of the core issue areas that matter most to young voters — the decision the court makes will deeply impact the lives of millions of borrowers across the country.
Excessive debt from seeking higher education likely impacts you or someone you know. This debt takes away from our ability to pay for food, housing, health care, and to start saving for our future. **But did you know that the student debt crisis is a racial justice issue as well?**
**Across the United States, 45 million borrowers owe approximately $2 trillion in student loan debt. But that debt isn’t divided equally among all borrowers.** Nearly 9 in 10 Black students take out federal student loans to pay for college, compared to 7 in 10 for their white counterparts.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59409756/394115658/1498205187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTdmYTQ4My04ZGI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zmy_eb6QqSlV5jbAEBAI0dfCG8hevygWRt7zqkbKlZU=&emci=7180904d-e6b6-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=717fa483-8db7-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59409758/394115660/1498205187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTdmYTQ4My04ZGI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zmy_eb6QqSlV5jbAEBAI0dfCG8hevygWRt7zqkbKlZU=&emci=7180904d-e6b6-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=717fa483-8db7-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=6787172)
**The facts of structural discrimination in student loan borrowing are clear.** As we prepare for the court’s decision to come down in the following months, we’re continuing to beat the drum for affordable pathways for higher education.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents - AND WIN! **

Your best gift today will help me fight for these jailed patriots, bring them justice, and fight for the future of our Great Nation.

You’re the key to making these pivotal fights as effective as possible.

[**So please give what you can right away.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651596%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rju7hLB6Piqbel4YdzSGKA&sysid=1)

| LATEST FROM GREATER GEORGIA
HOLDING DEKALB ACCOUNTABLE: Last week, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued a statement in support of SB 222, a new bill to keep outside money out of elections offices in Georgia. Thanks to our year-round election integrity efforts, were able to blow the whistle on the $2M grant accepted by DeKalb County Board of Elections earlier this month - and support critical legislative action to ensure special interests cannot buy influence in Georgia elections.
From the press release:
"What's happening right now in Georgia is crystal clear: ideological groups and certain counties are testing our resolve to enforce state law, while attempting to influence local elections," said Loeffler. "Thankfully, Lt. Governor Burt Jones and our lawmakers have taken swift action to fortify existing laws that ban outside funding for local boards of election through SB 222, which will ensure that our elections are never bought and paid for by special or partisan interests. Greater Georgia is proud to endorse the legislation, and calls for its urgent passage by members of the Georgia General Assembly."

clean_body: | | | | == | | | The Gold Dome Download Tuesday, February 28, 2023 We can't believe we are more than halfway through this year's legislative session. We're incredibly proud of our new conservative leaders and the direction they have taken this year. Georgians can expect to see major tax rebates/cuts, police support, school choice legislation, and much more. If you see a legislator, please be sure to thank them for their hard work! | | | LATEST LEGISLATION | Below you will find summaries of the top bills introduced in the legislature last week. Read the full bills by clicking the links below. SENATE BILL 222 About: Prevents outside money from influencing election offices. Sponsors: Senators Burns, Watson, Payne, Dixon, Ginn, and others. To read the bill, == SENATE BILL 233 About: A school choice bill that awards $6K scholarships for private schools. Sponsors: Senators Dolezal, Brass, Still, Moore, Setzler, and others. To read the bill, ==. HOUSE BILL 500 About: A bill to establish a penalty for arson against law enforcement vehicles. Sponsors: Representatives Silcox, Reeves, Hilton, Cheokas, and Daniel. To read the bill, ==. HOUSE BILL 505 About: A bill to expand the scope of actions considered a riot and ensure said actions are considered felonies. Sponsors: Representatives Cheokas, Silcox, Hilton, Daniel, and Reeves. To read the bill, ==. BILLS IN MOTION Below you will find summaries of other bills to watch as they progress through the legislative process. Read the full bills by clicking the links below. SENATE BILL 12 About: A bill to increase mandatory minimums for street crimes committed by convicted felons. Sponsors: Senators Albers, Robertson, Dugan, Payne, Beach, and others. Movement: Passed the Senate. To read the bill, ==. SENATE BILL 93 About: A bill to ban TikTok on state devices. Sponsors: Senators Anavitarte, Kennedy, Gooch, Robertson, Brass, and others. Movement: Passed the Senate. To read the bill, == SENATE BILL 63 About: A bill aimed at ending cash bail. Sponsors: Senators Robertson, Gooch, Brass, Anavitarte, Kennedy, and others. Movement: Passed the Senate. To read the bill, == HOUSE BILL 18 About: Mid year state budget. Sponsors: Representatives Burns, Jones, Efstration, and Hatchett. Movement: Passed both chambers, going to conference. To read the bill, == HOUSE BILL 162 About: $1B income tax rebates for Georgians. Sponsors: Senators Robertson, Gooch, Brass, Anavitarte, Kennedy, and others. Movement: Passed the House. To read the bill, == | | | KNOW YOUR STATE SENATE & HOUSE LEADERS | | | | Senator Jason Anavitarte Senator Jason Anavitarte represents the 31st Senate District which covers Dallas, Georgia. Senator Anavitarte is the Vice Chairman of the Natural Resources and the Environment Committee, and he sits on Appropriations, Ethics, Finance, Government Oversight, Reapportionment and Redistricting, Rules, Transportation, as well as Veterans, Military, and Homeland Security committees. This session, Senator Anavitarte has sponsored ==, including == which bans the use of TikTok on state devices. Click == to visit the Senate website. | | | | Representative Houston Gaines Representative Houston Gaines represents the 120th House District which encompasses Athens, Georgia. Rep. Gaines is the Vice-Chairman of the Subcommittee of Appropriation and he sits on the Creative Arts & Entertainment, Ethics, Governmental Affairs, Insurance, Public Health, Urban Affairs, and Ways & Means committees. This session, Rep. Gaines has sponsored ==, including == which aims at holding corrupt DA's accountable. Click == to visit the House website. | | | LATEST FROM GREATER GEORGIA HOLDING DEKALB ACCOUNTABLE: Last week, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued a statement in support of SB 222, a new bill to keep outside money out of elections offices in Georgia. Thanks to our year-round election integrity efforts, were able to blow the whistle on the $2M grant accepted by DeKalb County Board of Elections earlier this month - and support critical legislative action to ensure special interests cannot buy influence in Georgia elections. From the press release: "What's happening right now in Georgia is crystal clear: ideological groups and certain counties are testing our resolve to enforce state law, while attempting to influence local elections," said Loeffler. "Thankfully, Lt. Governor Burt Jones and our lawmakers have taken swift action to fortify existing laws that ban outside funding for local boards of election through SB 222, which will ensure that our elections are never bought and paid for by special or partisan interests. Greater Georgia is proud to endorse the legislation, and calls for its urgent passage by members of the Georgia General Assembly." To read the full press release, ==. | == | BLACK LEADERS ROUNDTABLE: Last week, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler met with Black conservative leaders from across the state of Georgia. The event was filled with lively conversations - where we discussed a range of ideas. We look forward to continuing our work with the Black community to advance our movement. A big thank you to all who participated! | | | | WASHINGTON WOES Last newsletter, we reported on the White House's disastrous handling of the train derailment and toxic spill in Ohio. We've got an update for you: 20 long days after the spill, Secretary of Transportation Pete Buttigieg visited East Palestine. | Friend,
I wanted to introduce you to **[Tusk](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJw9kEFvgzAMhX8N3IqCAwk9cOjaddImTbv2hEJiSjpCaAhC3a9fgrpJkaV8frbeM9Y547ys9pzQVNWCiQ5VqmsgQAlAlVOSwz7bt7KVJZXIqg5ygUlB0Ag9ZCJfhXPWmkxak_Z1USAjlAiWU2CkqKTqCqVEi0AUEhTpUPfeT3NCDwmcw1uxW0aFLs6Hr1_m79ig58WbRgozCX0dE3rybaPs2FjToGlWF-vTI0-ARfFsFycxSOOijRhUejGB4B-RdvQ4-oCetgNvxkGrQN5nfuj8_fZabbDXKrg8TZf2CCp3qavVtOph0DPjIf51ix9DB4-D7h51wl8SgG0MYMsH98tq3HIzH2-7r59yd2efpoxNOIbqHxP-K59Lsu2qkfLTL4_EgRA)** , my new one-of-a-kind web browser designed to promote censorship-free content that will restore free speech online.
**Our First Amendment is under attack** from all angles, but perhaps most prevalently online where Big Tech companies like Google censor and silence opposing views and sources.

Hey team -- I just talked to Fred, and we know you have questions about our work and why it is so crucial for our fair maps movement.
The best way to explain our work is by answering these three questions:
➡️ _How have our mapping tools helped fair redistricting processes?_
➡️ _How does our work involve communities of interest?_
➡️ _Why do we believe this work is so important and should be supported?_
---
**_First_** , our team has developed an extensive geospatial analytics toolbox. These tools have equipped us to rapidly identify gerrymandering using data-driven metrics and measure the extent of gerrymandering across the country.
[**When it comes to something as important as fair maps, looking at a district map just doesn’t cut it**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59411961/394123161/-1229800645?refcode=20230228_AOTL_F_EOM2_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyOGM2N2I0LTkxYjctZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uYULsv7Z8i5TbjPcXphPi6vTRu5MOA63_wvgjurHr44=) \-- you need additional resources and data to understand the real impact of district lines on communities of interest and political representation.
**_Next_** , communities of interest are at the heart of what we do. In addition to our data-driven approach, we help support and train volunteers to equip them with the tools to fight for fair maps in their communities.

body:
Let me show you a few reasons why:
#
Peter — Josh Hawley doesn’t know the Missouri I know.
Before I ask you to **[add a donation of any amount toward our end-of-month goal before our deadline at midnight tonight,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) let me show you a few reasons why:**
On the left is Joshua Hawley. While his banker daddy was sending him to a fancy prep school miles from his hometown, my family and I were relying on our neighbors to survive bankruptcy and medical bills in mid-Missouri — in a community where people took care of each other. That’s us on the right.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)
When Hawley graduated from law school, he joined one of the world’s most elite corporate law firms. I joined the Marine Corps to pay back the community in Missouri that took care of me and my family. And when he was climbing the ladder to become another corrupt politician, I was serving my country — and then working to prevent the pointless overseas wars that make us less safe.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)
While Josh Hawley aligned himself with the same giant corporations who’ve spent decades attacking Missouri workers and shipping away our jobs, I’ve been fighting to take back power for American workers and small businesses.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)
And when Hawley voted against relief for veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits, I stood up alongside thousands of veterans to hold him accountable.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)
**The Missouri I grew up in taught us to take care of one another.** To do your duty. To serve and sacrifice for your fellow Missourians.
**Josh Hawley doesn’t know that Missouri — and on January 6th, 2021, he showed us the only thing he’s learned is how to be a fraud and a coward.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)
Josh Hawley hasn't just abandoned our state and our values. He's embarrassed himself and all of Missouri. And embarrassing Missouri... That’s something I can't let go.
**Missourians deserve a U.S. Senator who’s willing and able to fight for them — and unlike Josh, I'm ready to serve.** If you’re ready to help us make sure every Missouri voter knows it before they vote on Election Day, I need your help:
**[Will you chip in any amount toward our end-of-month goal right now so we can start this campaign off strong and get our message in front of voters? Flipping this U.S. Senate seat will only be possible if we build a powerful grassroots movement, and early support from real people like you is the best way we can do it.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28086?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/28085?refcode=em20230228-2837&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=2837%2E614464%2EAsEH1V)

Our efforts pay off. The Fair Fight team works tirelessly in between election cycles to challenge voter suppression attempts as they come up and mobilize voters to make their voices heard at the ballot box. In 2022 alone, we engaged millions of voters online and over the phone with timely voting information, we endorsed and supported 56 Black and brown candidates, and we expanded voting access by advocating for additional polling locations and hours of operation across Georgia. As we look ahead to future elections, where Georgia will once again be a key battleground state, we’re relying on strong grassroots support to keep up our momentum.
We envision a hopeful future for voting rights, building on the incredible strength and resilience of the civil rights champions before us — from Fannie Lou Hamer to Mary Church Terrell to John Lewis. They bravely spoke out despite enduring violence against them to make so many of today’s freedoms possible, and we owe it to them to keep up the fight.
**This movement is only as strong as the people who step up and pitch in.** We need activists in your area and beyond to chip in whatever you can — before our midnight fundraising deadline tonight — to ensure we have the resources necessary to protect the freedom to vote and defy anti-democratic extremists. body:
This dream has always stuck with me.

| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkuac68drlfnknusrbg76ef5aa49t18p8frqlp60_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg69p34s9h2bs)
Fellow American,

I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

I might have been a skinny kid with a funny last name, but my parents taught me an important lesson: _If you are going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding._

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0dhb831lvh4nv2gt5fos99or0gvqim1t0s05apo_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg69p34s9h2bs)
Today, we're starting a cultural movement in our country, Fellow American, and I want you to be a part of it. I want you to join our movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.

This time it isn't just about money. It is about the unapologetic pursuit of excellence itself. It means that we:

Believe in merit.
Believe in accountability.
Believe in free speech.
Believe in American exceptionalism.
Fellow American, if you're on board with these ideals, then we're already on the same team. We're ready to fight for the future of America. If we rediscover our shared national identity, then we can take on the greatest external threat we face: Communist China.

**[Will you join me? Please take just a few minutes to watch my launch video- and join Team Vivek by chipping in $1 or even $5 today as I launch my presidential campaign.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziv30h26ldrj4p46m8fqfss2vc9n7sr37389f97o_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg69p34s9h2bs)**

It's time to stand up to the ruling aristocracy in America – in Washington D.C., on Wall Street, and in Silicon Valley – that does whatever allows them to accumulate more money and power for themselves. They try to divide & conquer, but that won't work if we stay united.

**E pluribus unum - _from many, one._**

These are the ideals that won the American Revolution; that reunited us after the Civil War; that won two World Wars and the Cold War. I believe deep in my bones these ideals still exist, and I am running for President to revive them.

Join me,

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2kqqn7m25jjlhjs9m014idkl97u2tnqbqspj8r8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg69p34s9h2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** WATCH NOW ->**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z70vrjll64p716821p6hhr1d172rg28dqa8a1ea8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdg69p34s9h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
2022 was an incredible year for Democrats, Peter.

We held the Senate, minimized losses in the House, and made inroads in
places we didn’t expect. In Kentucky, we over performed 2020 margins in
over half of all counties.

And through the highs and lows, we built a movement together. We engaged
young people and shared hope for progress with millions. We built lasting
infrastructure for the progressive movement and created new voters engaged
in the Democratic process.

Despite our loss on Election Day, we can be proud of what we accomplished
together. And I am excited to see what’s next for this team.

But right now, I have to ask again for your help. In order to close out
the campaign and move on to the next chapter of our work together, we have
some campaign debt to take care of. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18895?t=1001&akid=3015%2E346206%2E6SJOSW ]If you’re able, could you make a
contribution today to help us?

Our campaign was uncompromising. When we were making spending decisions in
the final days, that meant we prioritized communicating with as many
Kentucky voters as possible. We ran a bold campaign and we made bold
decisions. And unfortunately for us, that means we have a bit of a hole in
our budget and hope you can help us.

Thank you for anything you can do. I’m looking forward to what’s next.

Charles

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Suing Kaiser Permanente for abusing children
body:
Chloe Cole was just 13 years old when activist doctors decided

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, Chloe Cole was just 13 years old when activist doctors decided she was “trans”... _... and fast-tracked her into Kaiser Permanente’s multi-billion-dollar_ _industry to “transition” her from a girl to a boy._
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651598%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7aG%2bERKOR0CjJAJ9jJJF5g&sysid=1)
---
| |
* She was given weekly testosterone injections.
* She was injected with an experimental drug used to chemically castrate sex offenders.
* And finally, at age 15, the doctors at Kaiser Permanente removed Chloe’s healthy breasts in a radical double mastectomy.

---
| | Chloe and her parents were coerced by these doctors into thinking she was a boy. They purposefully lied to her about the side effects of the experimental treatments they were forcing her under. **And they effectively used Chloe as a lab rat to “test” their “gender affirming care.”** Now for the rest of Chloe’s life, her voice will always be deeper, she’ll never be able to breastfeed - if she can even have children - and who knows what cancers, fertility problems, cardiac problems, bone problems, and more lurk in her future. **Bottom line: The doctors at Kaiser Permanente destroyed Chloe’s healthy body for profit.** **And this is happening to children across America.** My non-profit, the Center for American Liberty, is helping Chloe Cole SUE Kaiser Permanente for permanently destroying her body... **... and finally bring justice to those who have suffered the same fate at the hands of doctors they should have been able to trust. ** [**I’m asking you to support Chloe’s landmark lawsuit today by contributing a tax-deductible donation of $35 to the case’s legal fund.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651599%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BN0sWIF%2bvHCdo7WgX8Uzow&sysid=1) Winning this case won’t be easy. Kaiser Permanente is the largest medical group in the country. They’re going to come at us with high-powered lawyers to protect their goldmine. **But making radical activists like this pay through litigation is the only way we’ll shut them down.** [**I’m counting on you to join me in Chloe’s fight today by supporting our legal battle with a tax-deductible $35 donation to our legal fund.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651590%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jVEz4jNyVV3E2AJT7OJ3%2fg&sysid=1) Any donation you can send today will get us one step closer to finally bringing Chloe the justice she deserves after being coerced and harmed by a hospital that abused her like a lab rat.
---

body:
Let’s set the record straight.

| |
---
| | | Let's set the record straight.

I fired Ilhan Omar because she was hurling anti-semitic and anti-American Remarks across social media. This is UNACCEPTABLE behavior for a member of a committee representing America on the world stage.

I fired Eric Swalwell from the intelligence committee because he became entangled with a spy for the Chinese Communist party. I do not have to explain to you why this would be a conflict of interest for someone sitting on the Intelligence Committee.

I fired Adam Schiff from the Intelligence Committee because he spread lies about Donald Trump's supposed involvement with Russia despite knowing them to be untrue at the time.
Adam Schiff leaked it?

I promised you that if we took back the majority, I would bring decency and justice to the people's House.

---
| | [PROMISES MADE](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztosiapglc95n2218po3je2efdvdv35f2hmm1hk8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi60o74cdh2bs)

---

I will not stop until we get this country back on track. But the Democrats are FURIOUS at what we have been doing.

Even now, Omar, Schiff, and Swalell are raising MILLIONS off their terminations. They will not stop until they return to power.

We cannot let this happen. I promise to fight with everything I have to stop this from happening, and with your support, we will succeed.

**[Can I ask that you chip in $1, $5, $10 or anything you might be able to give to help us take on the dark money Democrats and protect our Conservative House Majority?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5s2ui0ochb1nmcjr1ok2s26o8b24he625at9dmo_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi60o74cdh2bs "Can I ask that you chip in $1, $5, $10 or anything you might be able to give to help us take on the dark money Democrats and protect our Conservative House Majority?")**

Thank you,
Speaker Kevin McCarthy

-Olivia, Team Shapiro

**Begin Forwarded Message:**

**From:** Josh Shapiro
**Subject:** humbly asking
**Date:** February 27, 2023

**[Derek, Governor Josh Shapiro here and I’m humbly asking you to chip in $5 before our February fundraising deadline tomorrow night.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59415692/394137752/-2084059834?refcode=email_022723_eom1&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTE2ZTJhNi05YmI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_7HBqIdLWYm04eHfb3H9AZXPJ9MTE8pEMyMJuNjIQ8=)** | | [Donate now →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59415693/394137753/-2084059834?refcode=email_022723_eom1&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTE2ZTJhNi05YmI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_7HBqIdLWYm04eHfb3H9AZXPJ9MTE8pEMyMJuNjIQ8=)
