You’re probably wondering: _“Why do you need my support right now? Didn’t the election just happen?”_ You’re right, so let me take a minute to explain why your donations matter now more than ever.

I’m honored and humbled to wake up every day and go to work for the people of Pennsylvania. Serving as Governor is a responsibility I take seriously and don’t take for granted.

That’s why from day one, we got to work to make sure Pennsylvania is a place where everyone has the real freedom they deserve. We’ve taken real steps forward to open the doors of opportunity to workers, and we’ve fought to protect our fundamental civil rights.

I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished so far. But what we’re doing here in Pennsylvania couldn’t be more different than what we’re seeing Republicans try to do in DC. The new House Majority has already tried to restrict abortion rights, give tax breaks to the wealthy and some even want to gut Social Security and Medicare.

**[No matter what partisan fighting goes on in DC, I’ll always fight to make progress for the issues we care about. But Pennsylvania is always a battleground, and we need to do everything we can to make sure it stays blue for years to come. I need your continued support to keep up the fight here in Pennsylvania, and why your donation today is so important.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59415694/394137754/-2084059834?refcode=email_022723_eom1&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTE2ZTJhNi05YmI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_7HBqIdLWYm04eHfb3H9AZXPJ9MTE8pEMyMJuNjIQ8=)**

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Press Release from Erik Aadland
body:
| | | |
---
---
|
---
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE (February, 28, 2023) Candidate for Colorado GOP Chairman issues the following statement:
"Of the many important responsibilities of the Colorado Republican Party Chairman, I consider one of the most crucial to be remaining neutral in presiding over fair caucuses, state assemblies, primaries and the national convention delegate selection process.
It will be my objective to avoid the perceptions of non-neutrality in all primaries and assembly contests, including the primary election for President and the selection of RNC delegates and alternates. I will also be completely neutral with respect to adjudicating any issues between the state party and county parties, adhering perfectly to the bylaws.
Today, I am declaring that I will not publicly express support or opposition for any Republican running for President in 2024 before they are nominated by the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee. Unfortunately, several of my opponents for chairman can not make this declaration as they are already openly advocating for President Trump's re-election. This predilection calls into question their motivations, integrity, and ability to remain neutral as chairman in running the RNC delegate election process, thereby making them unfit for this position."
---
| |
---
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a former Congressional Candidate (CO-7), West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

body:
This is a simple but very important thing you can do for our campaign today.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=10%2E791427%2E3hK_fy)
Friends -
I wanted to reach out to you today with a simple, but very important request.
As you know, emails like this one are critical to the success of our campaign. They're a vital part of how we fundraise, organize, and stay in touch with our movement all across the country.
Now, mailbox providers — like Gmail, Yahoo, and many, many others — use certain metrics to decide whether a message ends up in your inbox, or it ends up in your spam, never to be seen again.
Two of the most important of these metrics are how many people are opening our emails, and how many people are clicking links inside them. The more our supporters do that, the better reputation we get with the mailbox providers.
Now, you've obviously already opened this email. That's huge — thank you. Now I'm hoping you can take the next step and click the link below to help us even further.
As a bonus, my team found our 2018 campaign launch video from the archives and thought it'd be a great one to share. Take a look:
**[https://act.IlhanOmar.com/go/Click-This-Link](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/16?t=2&akid=10%2E791427%2E3hK_fy)**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/16?t=3&akid=10%2E791427%2E3hK_fy)
I know this seems like a silly favor to ask, so let me explain a bit further:
This month, our team is in the process of migrating to a new platform to send these emails out of, and we really need to start off on the right foot and not end up marked as spam in our supporters' inboxes.
The best way for us to do that is by lots and lots of people engaging with our emails through opening and clicking links.
I know it sounds a bit strange, but it's the truth. My team could definitely tell you more about the technical side of all this, but that's the long story short. So I'm asking you directly:
**[Can you click this link to help ensure your mailbox provider delivers our campaign's emails where they're supposed to go? This is a simple but very important step that would mean a lot to our success.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/16?t=4&akid=10%2E791427%2E3hK_fy)**
As always, thank you.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62376070:6W_c83GJN:m:1:3331421248:A83936571B907C5142F1A2AFBD4F0454:r)

Peter,

There's a plague worse than COVID that no one is allowed to talk about -- the victimhood mentality.

This plantation of the mind traps people into believing that they are powerless. It prevents them from seeing themselves as anything but a victim.

**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.**

The victimhood mentality is destroying the Black family. It's killing our children with abortion. It's keeping us dependent on government welfare.

My name is Candace Owens, and I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation to SHATTER the victimhood mentality in America. And to help do that, I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support education and resources for these communities.

[_**Can you help leave a legacy of freedom and victory instead of oppression and victimhood? Click here to rush your support >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62376070:6W_c83GJN:m:1:3331421248:A83936571B907C5142F1A2AFBD4F0454:r)

I, too, once believed the narrative of victimhood until my grandfather told me a story that changed my life. _It taught me never to be a victim again_.

My grandfather grew up during the Jim Crow era and lived through real racism -- not this fake racism you see in the media.

As a boy, he worked on the family's share crop farm. Each morning he would wake up at 4 am to lay out the tobacco to dry. **Despite their difficult circumstances, they stayed together as a family and persevered. **

**Then one night, the KKK showed up. **

My grandfather woke up to the sound of gunshots. Bullets came flying through the walls of his home. He and his siblings had to hide underneath their beds.

_But a smirk always came across my grandfather 's face when he told me what happened next. _

_**" My father got his shotgun and fired back at them boys!" **_

My grandfather was proud of how, in the face of this real danger, his father refused to cower and fought back!

I've been the target of racism and death threats because I've spoken out about my beliefs. But I'm not going to let that stop me.

I overcame the victimhood mentality and want to help offer others the education and resources to do the same.

[_**Will you send a gift to END the victimhood mentality?**__**Click here to rush your support >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62376070:6W_c83GJN:m:1:3331421248:A83936571B907C5142F1A2AFBD4F0454:r)

Here's how BLEXIT is connecting with Black and minority communities:

We put together **BLEXIT 's Guide Against Critical Race Theory** for parents, grandparents, and teachers.

This guide walks you through how to spot Critical Race Theory (CRT) in the classroom and gives examples so you can spot it. It also explains the rights of students and parents and offers ways to fight back.

This resource encourages people to think critically about the victim mentality promoted by CRT and how it affects the next generation.

**In addition to our online resources, BLEXIT State Chapter members bring our inspirational message directly to their communities.**

Our state chapters are the hands and feet of BLEXIT. Our volunteers and state chapter leaders are changing the narrative surrounding America's minority communities through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

We currently have 43 chapters across the nation made up of more than 14,000 volunteers!

Your generous support will give people access and a platform to realize that they're more powerful than they can imagine and help them break free from the victimhood mentality.

Will you chip in today and help us reach our February goal of raising $50,000 to reach Black and minority communities? Click below to donate.

clean_body: Peter, There's a plague worse than COVID that no one is allowed to talk about -- the victimhood mentality. This plantation of the mind traps people into believing that they are powerless. It prevents them from seeing themselves as anything but a victim. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor. The victimhood mentality is destroying the Black family. It's killing our children with abortion. It's keeping us dependent on government welfare. My name is Candace Owens, and I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation to SHATTER the victimhood mentality in America. And to help do that, I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support education and resources for these communities. I, too, once believed the narrative of victimhood until my grandfather told me a story that changed my life. It taught me never to be a victim again. My grandfather grew up during the Jim Crow era and lived through real racism -- not this fake racism you see in the media. As a boy, he worked on the family's share crop farm. Each morning he would wake up at 4 am to lay out the tobacco to dry. Despite their difficult circumstances, they stayed together as a family and persevered. Then one night, the KKK showed up. My grandfather woke up to the sound of gunshots. Bullets came flying through the walls of his home. He and his siblings had to hide underneath their beds. But a smirk always came across my grandfather 's face when he told me what happened next. " My father got his shotgun and fired back at them boys!" My grandfather was proud of how, in the face of this real danger, his father refused to cower and fought back! I've been the target of racism and death threats because I've spoken out about my beliefs. But I'm not going to let that stop me. I overcame the victimhood mentality and want to help offer others the education and resources to do the same. Here's how BLEXIT is connecting with Black and minority communities: We put together BLEXIT 's Guide Against Critical Race Theory for parents, grandparents, and teachers. This guide walks you through how to spot Critical Race Theory (CRT) in the classroom and gives examples so you can spot it. It also explains the rights of students and parents and offers ways to fight back. This resource encourages people to think critically about the victim mentality promoted by CRT and how it affects the next generation. In addition to our online resources, BLEXIT State Chapter members bring our inspirational message directly to their communities. Our state chapters are the hands and feet of BLEXIT. Our volunteers and state chapter leaders are changing the narrative surrounding America's minority communities through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events. We currently have 43 chapters across the nation made up of more than 14,000 volunteers! Your generous support will give people access and a platform to realize that they're more powerful than they can imagine and help them break free from the victimhood mentality. Will you chip in today and help us reach our February goal of raising $50,000 to reach Black and minority communities? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. body:
Let’s set the record straight.

| |

| | | Let’s set the record straight.

I fired Ilhan Omar because she was hurling anti-semitic and anti-American Remarks across social media. This is UNACCEPTABLE behavior for a member of a committee representing America on the world stage.

I fired Eric Swalwell from the intelligence committee because he became entangled with a spy for the Chinese Communist party. I do not have to explain to you why this would be a conflict of interest for someone sitting on the Intelligence Committee.

I fired Adam Schiff from the Intelligence Committee because he spread lies about Donald Trump’s supposed involvement with Russia despite knowing them to be untrue at the time.
Adam Schiff leaked it?

I promised you that if we took back the majority, I would bring decency and justice to the people’s House.

clean_body: The DNC’s fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. They’re building for 2023 and beyond and counting on our support to make critical investments while it’s still early. | | Derek, If you took one thing from my State of the Union address earlier this month, I hope it’s this: We’ve made a lot of progress together in these past two years, but we’re not finished by any stretch of the imagination. It’s time to finish the job, which means electing more Democrats across the country. One of the most powerful ways you can help make that happen is by supporting the Democratic National Committee ahead of tonight’s fundraising deadline. The DNC supports the resources that Democrats running up and down the ticket are relying on to win in the coming years. A grassroots donation of just a few bucks has so much value and importance in what it can do to support Democrats nationwide. If you can, I hope you’ll support our party by donating $7 to the DNC before tonight’s deadline. We’ve got a long road ahead to finish the job of building a better America, but I’ve seen firsthand what the American people can do when we work together. Derek, your early support will ensure Democrats have what they need to win races in every corner of our country. And that’s exactly how we can keep delivering for families nationwide. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The moment I knew I had to run
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I never planned on running for Congress, or any office for that matter.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=33%2E135344%2EOKXokt)
Friend -
Yesterday was a pretty incredible day for the start of our campaign. All across Michigan and the rest of the country, people chipped in to support this race. We raised _more than a million dollars in twelve hours_ -- I’m so, so grateful to everyone that added to the outpouring of support. Thank you.
It’s funny, when I started my career in public service, I never imagined running for Congress, let alone the United States Senate.
I spent most of my career in national security. While I served under Presidents Bush and Obama, I didn’t consider myself an overly “political” person – in fact, my role was expressly apolitical. I served our country in my roles at the Pentagon and within the White House, guided only by concern for our nation.
After the 2016 election, my time in the executive branch ended, because I had been a political appointee for President Obama. So I started to explore what it would look like to get politically involved. I started going to local Democratic club meetings and talking to people in my community. But it was one moment in particular that brought everything into focus for me.
It was May 4, 2017.
I was sitting in my living room in Holly watching live CNN coverage of the Rose Garden ceremony President Trump held after the House passed legislation to repeal the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
I caught sight of my then-Congressman, smiling and beaming with pride that he had just voted to repeal protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
That was it. Something inside of me broke. I thought to myself: _“No. You don’t get to ignore your constituents, vote against their interests, and keep your job.”_
We have a term for this in the military community: it’s called dereliction of duty. It’s a fireable offense. We decided that day we would fire him, and in November 2018, we did just that.
**Health care is why I started running for office. It is personal to me.**
In 2011, my mom died of ovarian cancer. She had thankfully beaten cancer as a young mom, but for the rest of her life she had a pre-existing condition -- which meant getting health care coverage was always a struggle.
When she did have coverage, it was her highest bill, over $1,000 per month with a $10,000 deductible.
And when she was diagnosed in 2009 with advanced ovarian cancer, unbeknownst to our family, she had let her coverage lapse in order to pay other bills.
I ran for the House, and today I am running for Senate, because no family should have to decide between paying for utilities or the health insurance or prescription drugs they need to stay healthy.
I know I won’t be able to run this race and win alone, it’s going to take a big team, which is why I have to ask:
[Will you make your first donation to my campaign for Senate in Michigan? I know we can win this race and get to work in the Senate on these issues that affect all of our lives.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-febu23.o9qbqY&refcode=em230228-1-7&t=2&akid=33%2E135344%2EOKXokt)

body:
This Shocked Me... I have been very fortunate at a young age to have had the opportunity to preach the Gospel in all kinds of settings to all differe
| | |
---
## This Shocked Me...
---
I have been _very fortunate_ at a young age to have had the opportunity to preach the **Gospel** in all kinds of settings to all different kinds of people. Typically, it is easy to identify if the sermon is making a significant impact or not while in the midst of preaching it. This past Sunday, I preached a sermon at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10725.1.d154306bb7ca95cd6eaef3ee7fd973e1) entitled: [TRIGGERED](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10726.1.7c0964b19a471738130d2cbf071e0cc2).
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10727.1.1861fe0150030acac07782cb9ba8429b)
---
This sermon, I did not think was one of my greatest sermons ever preached but **something incredible happened**.
I preached the message at our 9am and 11am services. I gave no altar call but instead led our church family in Communion at the end of service.
Upon, finishing Communion, I then dismissed everyone and did my usual thing which is to shake the hand of every person at our church for both services.
I left the church around 1pm and as soon as I got home **my phone started exploding** with text messages and emails from the members of [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10728.1.69953cc62fb4eceaceee9e70d52d9bc3) sharing with me their testimony of what they experienced God do during the sermon.
The volume of testimonies was incredible and the description of freedom that so many experienced **shocked me** because on the surface I did not see anything taking place other than God's people simply receiving God's Word.
**I believe that this message can do the same for you as well.**
Check this message out: [TRIGGERED](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10729.1.1b609e3e7502f3a34854a39a7f1c4244)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

## Who Is The Antichrist?
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=18426569.10738.1.e158936270d8256c9e11a6801f8055da)
---

name: ICYMI News
subject: Put Constitution 101 on television
body:
There's startling statistics I want to share with you today, but don't worry, I also have some exciting news.

Dear Fellow American, Can you do me a favor?
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgtdbhba6im2jp4alnlnv2ibifi6qkanv7jfrs20_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61o34cth2bs) Hi there, Friend. There's startling statistics I want to share with you today, but don't worry, I also have some exciting news. First, the shocking stuff... Recent surveys show that 57% of Americans haven't read the Constitution. So when you are walking through your neighborhood, chances are good that in every house you pass, one person who lives there hasn't read one of our most important founding documents! But there's one more stat I'd like to give you...
26% cannot name a **single right** protected by the First Amendment--not freedom of religion, not free speech, not freedom of assembly--not a single one. These startling statistics show that if we hope to restore liberty in America, we must teach millions of our neighbors about the design and purpose of our Constitution. It's the only way to protect our freedom for the long term. That's why we've been working on a brand new way to do this...one that I'm excited to share with you today. For months, we have worked to produce a version of our most popular free online course, "**Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution** ," that we are airing on television networks nationwide. In other words, we are bringing **["Constitution 101" directly into the homes of millions of Americans. In fact, our current media plan has the spot reaching as many as 70 million households over one month!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1v6f96q48vch0hmpgrubad47be5rq565h6kjes0_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61o34cth2bs)**
## Is television good for teaching young Americans how the Constitution works?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8edv8m3uondd3tg76qb6io6igl76aou0aqb15e0_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61o34cth2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zksb2luqg2snvpfo87v1u96c7ta92nqs99n2krhg_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61o34cth2bs) Imagine citizens of all ages learning about the design and purpose of the Constitution...imagine them having the chance to understand the beauty of our founding documents and how they've been undermined. Most of all, imagine millions of people learning how we might revive limited government in our time! You can see why I'm excited about this and why it's so important that I share this with you today. This new effort is a major escalation of our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions...which has as its aim nothing less than educating as many of our fellow Americans as possible --so we can save our country.** This new television program redoubles our efforts to **reach** and **teach** citizens of all ages about the Constitution and liberty. It's also why we urgently need your support. You might be surprised to learn that airing "Constitution 101" on television networks isn't as expensive as you might think. To air the **_30-minute_ program** and other spots across dozens of networks for **one month** costs just **$275,000...total**. name: 1600 Daily
subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhg2rcsqj6eti48pdccvdam7to5nh8bekoot9gi0_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61oj4cph2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

In an interview published in _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s digest of liberty, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court Clarence Thomas explained what he sees as his role on the nation’s highest court: **“My job is to apply the Constitution.”**

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjuearcgbkp222a0slv5pvqivkb1o5vln6lp8i1o_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61oj4cph2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z72lvgfn3chm7rvn9l2d06a0mmscdrtodg66tuuo_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61oj4cph2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zacch0sbq0ilqic7l9spk93rd14tifmvgf1rg6pg_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61oj4cph2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty--featuring issues such as “Clarence Thomas and the Lost Constitution.”

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z78nl5btm94rbsfeqd3mjp0pmtc99tirr3lsqfvg_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdi61oj4cph2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

---

body:
You’re a valuable supporter and I feel like I can ask you directly.
| | |
---
I can’t believe it – it’s already late February.
To fight the onslaught of GOP money and close polling in the days before Election Day, my campaign took on debt. Pundits moved our race to a toss-up, and I was getting calls from other Senators concerned that we couldn’t win.

Peter,

Joe Biden has been using his office to attack our Second Amendment like no president has ever done before. During his State of the Union address, he said that he plans on BANNING the most popular firearms in America.

**" BAN THEM NOW, ONCE AND FOR ALL!"**

His agenda is _unprecedented_ , and we can't let his vision become our country's reality. **Now more than ever, the NRA 's work is of the utmost importance.** That's why it's vital that we reach our February fundraising goal.

**[Chip in ANY AMOUNT NOW to help the NRA reach its February goal and support our continued efforts to REJECT Biden's gun-grabbing agenda. >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62375734:6GHjp3GNU:m:1:3365131770:7BC52648243B59BE426CBD9063D4F39D:r)**

With your help, we will continue fighting for the right to self-defense, your individual liberties, and the Second Amendment.

**Peter,_are you with us?_**

**[Please donate whatever you can to our End-of-Month fund to support the NRA as we head deeper into 2023.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/62375734:6GHjp3GNU:m:1:3365131770:7BC52648243B59BE426CBD9063D4F39D:r)**

The National Rifle Association

Fellow American,

I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

I might have been a skinny kid with a funny last name, but my parents taught me an important lesson: _If you are going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding._

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f72be7247bbb4ea187c368bb7f947778&_e=aOFFgQR8plS42MyjuhLMFUeniLGJpiRAvqskHvkH4VpfLlb_GHOvj0BPsyuK3chX1R0AHPrcft3VdfLrJxFfkn4lyRgU7ktpuFcDNb1Tw1skzXKDKDYIohGz9o35TrYm-x3Tv-N4bxF1rPTfP5moxERkJ6uoW1dCrLx8al5iRWLaycmMww0K7dgTtykRlud87Ag_6xb5VAN00aFW1OwARXAtcYTbUyGbRYB4NJJnxXr6GdMkfgDhiCv-wV1tkTROaFPma4jKXPtT8XgQZXjiMPtHEHHqyLL5ExOjSWU0Fw-TfgmCrcP69TpiCgXvHlN3SmcA5E4d_CmR78BIGlgSk9NfJpJIdhE10zB7r-DebE2TS_889F6RM65hU2nBRuBkTEGns1scjWq9q5viDoS9Iw%3D%3D)
Today, we're starting a cultural movement in our country, Fellow American, and I want you to be a part of it. I want you to join our movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.

This time it isn't just about money. It is about the unapologetic pursuit of excellence itself. It means that we:

Believe in merit.
Believe in accountability.
Believe in free speech.
Believe in American exceptionalism.
Fellow American, if you're on board with these ideals, then we're already on the same team. We're ready to fight for the future of America. If we rediscover our shared national identity, then we can take on the greatest external threat we face: Communist China.

**[Will you join me? Please take just a few minutes to watch my launch video- and join Team Vivek by chipping in $1 or even $5 today as I launch my presidential campaign.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f72be7247bbb4ea187c368bb7f947778&_e=aOFFgQR8plS42MyjuhLMFUeniLGJpiRAvqskHvkH4VpfLlb_GHOvj0BPsyuK3chX1R0AHPrcft3VdfLrJxFfkn4lyRgU7ktpuFcDNb1Tw1skzXKDKDYIohGz9o35TrYm-x3Tv-N4bxF1rPTfP5moxERkJ6uoW1dCrLx8al5iRWLaycmMww0K7dgTtykRlud87Ag_6xb5VAN00aFW1OwARXAtcYTbUyGbRYB4NJJnxXr6GdMkfgDhiCv-wV1tkTROa2HOXQ49qnbxksYZsGGXZdcuP-Mf2Oobd_m4oqgzx3Owur7QZMWptT_RWBI1bxY78OsLshfggjYKY95Pzu2IZzOQABDqfmXdXcL8L6Fj5xJWnyeePWXGaRpM5ki4F-WD2MA3Gc_jjKugf7gekNYv5g%3D%3D)**

It's time to stand up to the ruling aristocracy in America - in Washington D.C., on Wall Street, and in Silicon Valley - that does whatever allows them to accumulate more money and power for themselves. They try to divide & conquer, but that won't work if we stay united.

**E pluribus unum - _from many, one._**

These are the ideals that won the American Revolution; that reunited us after the Civil War; that won two World Wars and the Cold War. I believe deep in my bones these ideals still exist, and I am running for President to revive them.

One week ago today, I launched my campaign for President of the United States.

| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651667%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vRpR7l%2bUa10LtRGMn9GMDQ&sysid=1)
Fellow American,

As a successful business entrepreneur, I can tell you firsthand from experience - the most successful business ventures are those that disrupt their industry's status quo.

It's this approach that helped me launch several multi-billion-dollar companies.

When I decided to speak out against wokeness in corporate culture, I disrupted the status quo. Now, the left criticizes me with a bunch of labels: "The intellectual godfather of the anti-woke movement" (Politico). "CEO of Anti-Woke, Inc.," (The New Yorker). The "right's leading anti-ESG crusader," (Bloomberg). I wear it as a badge of honor.

Now, in launching my campaign for President of the United States earlier this month, my goal is to **disrupt the status quo in America** and restore values like **faith** , **patriotism** , and **hard work** as core tenants of our identity as Americans.

I am unabashed in my views and goals, and it was clear from Day One that our movement was disruptive to those who are opposed to these values. _**But we're just getting started.**_

I am now up against my very first fundraising deadline of my campaign for President - **the February month-end deadline.**

| [** SECURE FIRST-MONTH SUPPORTER STATUS →**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651668%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sf3f9UpmEMQYjauCTg%2bLGA&sysid=1)

We are going to disrupt the status quo in America and once again become a nation where the American Dream is alive and well.

**[Please be among the first to join in this fight!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VgIILp%2f0fmMT%2blK6UaWt3A&sysid=1)**

Vivek Ramaswamy

[** DONATE TODAY →**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c651664%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fHCs%2fzzD3NjTMxOnPGviBQ&sysid=1)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | Dear Friend,Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we’ve really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That’s why I’m sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](http://trk.readactnews.-7a7tz_nQ0QAbA)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you’ll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you’ll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment—and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

You can get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/](http://trk.readactnews.)**.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It’s important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zshn9lpcqq1j4fi5b4repoed97d2lrvb3nsbd7c0_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdh6aoj2chh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

In an interview published in _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s digest of liberty, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court Clarence Thomas explained what he sees as his role on the nation’s highest court: **“My job is to apply the Constitution.”**

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf2fvkp57lo5pmo02lfnpe576gvvk2o8fuh2hr08_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdh6aoj2chh2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbm87mubkgbjufsaj794s4ck4q9j03au0u8a4dm8_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdh6aoj2chh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlm5te7crman0hsv85eihhfjoflilc8q3ki3p48g_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdh6aoj2chh2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty--featuring issues such as “Clarence Thomas and the Lost Constitution.”

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z434tqputtk1eehqmqgg2kvielp84dorusvelm0o_rp22sh2s8i66pr7cdh6aoj2chh2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

---

body:
If you're going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding.

| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6412c701ae064449b3c91d4169a36ec1&_e=jUrI7f4SAYveAHZpVenY3vu46zQrzL9vZ6YHVt_juu5aTYe2yVRxhhG0kkbupRXsvtP4e-P73I7Y0xwIvJXwAe2uyrKmn17-L1AV9Ou7KHXDW3_yn9b8X7bu3q30CNK9CfMbgHkwefkPO8tWREHb-YgJV4bWNiOhNqtWQU3_aAlPNj3nTUOGJIvKR5xNibDKZLOCXYtZ-q_d8ZHpk0q5QwJXpgdj_YoaEzQCAN_CkO35shHcslEQH_wCu6OhNVEqb7kgF87k1iwxsjTSCG6csQsGirQkLQvckrPCvrtm3sd_SoPFTrqLvYxBgoGa0OezpJ8WGbWSMA5ZKlzIZVZptW9zQJYwRb7ZDqd6mmRC3l1tf0m7EhMDi5MW7Hj5twnOZOeW5t3MCrl0TyAXuwynTA%3D%3D)
Fellow American,

I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

I might have been a skinny kid with a funny last name, but my parents taught me an important lesson: _If you are going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding._

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6412c701ae064449b3c91d4169a36ec1&_e=jUrI7f4SAYveAHZpVenY3vu46zQrzL9vZ6YHVt_juu5aTYe2yVRxhhG0kkbupRXsvtP4e-P73I7Y0xwIvJXwAe2uyrKmn17-L1AV9Ou7KHXDW3_yn9b8X7bu3q30CNK9CfMbgHkwefkPO8tWREHb-YgJV4bWNiOhNqtWQU3_aAlPNj3nTUOGJIvKR5xNibDKZLOCXYtZ-q_d8ZHpk0q5QwJXpgdj_YoaEzQCAN_CkO35shHcslEQH_wCu6OhNVEqLBa5QN2b320EVBeqEBn-ipd2xy-FYxlrJdlwPjaymEnCsr_M6QLlpPWZ1PUOtJ3Zu_yw2JMZaWkxnoI7auA7CWDab2D725ZRNcOsxweYzW_6bRxkuPL0VCw194vE5R6P7IjtsxG5TUGC58ePyJ2GNQ%3D%3D)
Today, we're starting a cultural movement in our country, Fellow American, and I want you to be a part of it. I want you to join our movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.

This time it isn't just about money. It is about the unapologetic pursuit of excellence itself. It means that we:

Believe in merit.
Believe in accountability.
Believe in free speech.
Believe in American exceptionalism.
Fellow American, if you're on board with these ideals, then we're already on the same team. We're ready to fight for the future of America. If we rediscover our shared national identity, then we can take on the greatest external threat we face: Communist China.

**[Will you join me? Please take just a few minutes to watch my launch video- and join Team Vivek by chipping in $1 or even $5 today as I launch my presidential campaign.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6412c701ae064449b3c91d4169a36ec1&_e=jUrI7f4SAYveAHZpVenY3vu46zQrzL9vZ6YHVt_juu5aTYe2yVRxhhG0kkbupRXsvtP4e-P73I7Y0xwIvJXwAe2uyrKmn17-L1AV9Ou7KHXDW3_yn9b8X7bu3q30CNK9CfMbgHkwefkPO8tWREHb-YgJV4bWNiOhNqtWQU3_aAlPNj3nTUOGJIvKR5xNibDKZLOCXYtZ-q_d8ZHpk0q5QwJXpgdj_YoaEzQCAN_CkO35shHcslEQH_wCu6OhNVEqgjsxnc-S6TOlG3fd7dLEwFZKFVOBBhTpaGx_lQwUfCvv0nHohFEG1zF9WMU_XFpfQkToyXBqc5HfwUV7GwUfE-sG9rCxJgwJQi6M6M5F0R8peRKAFfWa96Aq2QHacTUH7SiB7Sdof2oEgNDRp6NUfA%3D%3D)**

It's time to stand up to the ruling aristocracy in America - in Washington D.C., on Wall Street, and in Silicon Valley - that does whatever allows them to accumulate more money and power for themselves. They try to divide & conquer, but that won't work if we stay united.

**E pluribus unum - _from many, one._**

These are the ideals that won the American Revolution; that reunited us after the Civil War; that won two World Wars and the Cold War. I believe deep in my bones these ideals still exist, and I am running for President to revive them.

Join me,

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6412c701ae064449b3c91d4169a36ec1&_e=jUrI7f4SAYveAHZpVenY3vu46zQrzL9vZ6YHVt_juu5aTYe2yVRxhhG0kkbupRXsvtP4e-P73I7Y0xwIvJXwAe2uyrKmn17-L1AV9Ou7KHXDW3_yn9b8X7bu3q30CNK9CfMbgHkwefkPO8tWREHb-YgJV4bWNiOhNqtWQU3_aAlPNj3nTUOGJIvKR5xNibDKZLOCXYtZ-q_d8ZHpk0q5QwJXpgdj_YoaEzQCAN_CkO35shHcslEQH_wCu6OhNVEqGsN5a45qZ7lb1HOnMbvXahohQvpbDtmJEstS5V_gtFHP16Ucwy3UhQ8Lh6Qdm93fRirCnrAR4fMAb7KbTuKw7yjSIfimgoOZLTHIYfZThdqKPprn9ph1aQwd0XvJM6dbQYamQdqhBlsEPNNuISeD_Q%3D%3D)
Vivek Ramaswamy

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | | Here's how you can help | | Hey, it’s Charlie, executive director of the Arizona Democratic Party.

| 2023 SESSION WEEK 7 OVERVIEW

Dear Friends, The Virginia Senate officially adjourned today, Saturday, February 25 at 5pm. We have completed our work for the 2023 legislative session on all of our bills.
Unfortunately, we have not fully completed our work on the budget and we will have to return for a Special Session to be called by the Governor. Today, we passed a "skinny budget," which is one of the few budgets I've supported over the course of 8 years. In my opinion, we need more "skinny budgets" with less spending and more tax cutting.
As for now, all legislators are headed back home to run for re-election, until reconvene for the purposes of unfinished business on Wednesday, April 12. Now that we have adjourned, we can continue to raise money to run for re-election. Please consider making a [donation today](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BFFYd3kxRUNilkdCnCKkB_VSSJ3AWZuUBPTkO4Ex1GY7SvOxCNgA3200qFQniyrIg-VcfyO593ZrMRcj7K1DfygY1DhKfR7NW5u_kXARefZtia2LicPJWrVTeXfFlF3zaUgOku1lFC-70-VKAIjlP_hJnRridDeRevwzwpAjfc2dgJQnZMz_1t7BdzJJAZOkFdi0-BD2fe_68MZA_w7sVw==&c=ywJNiVgoV1RE2moxiY3hQd_KqQcOKEqtVAvlzH_2HJC9v2PhZozPXg==&ch=hjqIj5i0CjMuO_TwsQtiCL4pFhSoEMKCUWTF7zgOy_yVpRCH3s6J2g==)[.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BFFYd3kxRUNilkdCnCKkB_VSSJ3AWZuUBPTkO4Ex1GY7SvOxCNgA31IpA1tLO-SXP4ToDEdYd2XLf0XZpPzojRh9NZtJm921cjzNweZIYBI8xwi2uCVI8oOMP37Kxy9aiGu-aSERdI44_2Y8e98WBesnbM3Woq5P8eSr6hUdOBU=&c=ywJNiVgoV1RE2moxiY3hQd_KqQcOKEqtVAvlzH_2HJC9v2PhZozPXg==&ch=hjqIj5i0CjMuO_TwsQtiCL4pFhSoEMKCUWTF7zgOy_yVpRCH3s6J2g==)
Between now and April 12 the Governor will review bills that have passed the General Assembly and chose to sign, veto or amend these bills. When the General Assembly returns on April 12 for "reconvene," also called the "veto" session, we will approve or reject the Governor's amendments or attempt to override any vetoes.
But first, here's a quick assessment of bills that actually survived. There are not many. Almost all of the most controversial bills put forward died, due to the split assembly. Here are a few bills that did pass both the House and Senate, several of these bills I was a copatron as noted:

1. A bill passed that would allow gun owners to claim a tax rebate of up to $300 dollars for buying a firearm lockbox or somewhere to store their firearm safely. And that would go into effect in this tax year and would last five years. And again, you could claim up to $300 dollars.
2. A bill passed that was carried by Sen. [Steve Newman](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BFFYd3kxRUNilkdCnCKkB_VSSJ3AWZuUBPTkO4Ex1GY7SvOxCNgA3200qFQniyrIqM1XKrmSxdkAePdRpwexP-FGtm8iW-xT_tZPhx0hcxg_ChPuQqXO9OyYU9Jp8AZILoujJZUBfq4ei7GcT87EXn2sdYmlXa5qUnLjIuJ2HqEqAkfGjP33GUiegIkYnepD3dMzU-WbM1E4IQubChWZQRgHD1Z0MCf1&c=ywJNiVgoV1RE2moxiY3hQd_KqQcOKEqtVAvlzH_2HJC9v2PhZozPXg==&ch=hjqIj5i0CjMuO_TwsQtiCL4pFhSoEMKCUWTF7zgOy_yVpRCH3s6J2g==) , R-Bedford, and I served as a co-sponsor, that would allow colleges and universities to access health and criminal history records of students who pose a significant threat on campus. Virginia's colleges and universities would be permitted to obtain criminal histories and health records of people seen as posing a "significant" threat on campuses . This legislation was filed in response to the November shooting at the University of Virginia that left three football players dead.
3. A bill passed from Sen. Richard Stuart, R-King George, to prohibit foreign governments from making agricultural land purchases. This is probably my favorite bill that passed this year. Under the bill, the ban would apply to foreign governments or others the U.S. Secretary of Commerce has determined "to have engaged in a long-term pattern or serious instances of conduct significantly adverse to the national security of the United States or security and safety of United States persons." The bill would impose the ban starting Jan. 1, 2023, meaning it would go into effect once it is signed, but it would not void farmland purchases made before 2023. The legislation also requires the Virginia Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services to provide a yearly report to the governor and General Assembly on the farmland owned by foreign governments. The [current list of "foreign adversaries"](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BFFYd3kxRUNilkdCnCKkB_VSSJ3AWZuUBPTkO4Ex1GY7SvOxCNgA3200qFQniyrIhPdnfZHI-0f84yRz1wH5BYlK--hTpNWnQpR6X7BDrnTnHdrO4inF6phMxU_PV_bi5HYqnQk1M7TWI6lZD57wMHSLbKI9gV3BD5x91QIVUarbH3MEC8iScNWSEKLlrSMBctxrGwHZxok_qaNhlTRQ5zVOzrkaVCocP-7ZeGWciGY=&c=ywJNiVgoV1RE2moxiY3hQd_KqQcOKEqtVAvlzH_2HJC9v2PhZozPXg==&ch=hjqIj5i0CjMuO_TwsQtiCL4pFhSoEMKCUWTF7zgOy_yVpRCH3s6J2g==) recognized by the U.S. includes The People's Republic of China, the Republic of Cuba, the Islamic Republic of Iran, North Korea, Russia and Venezuelan politician Nicolas Maduro. In 2021, the U.S. Department of Agriculture found foreign entities and persons held an interest in [nearly 41 million acres](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BFFYd3kxRUNilkdCnCKkB_VSSJ3AWZuUBPTkO4Ex1GY7SvOxCNgA3200qFQniyrICin9s14sr7CPJG7xW_pFY66a4hAxwCUb4GhTB_T1L1Mi-J7kCYEKMwn5yrtI6VsuAPQq0xXtpTt75XeHvnPd5KR7JyLaYrxR9KVAZFaDyMZotVs7Oqs2HFVXznLpaU5d&c=ywJNiVgoV1RE2moxiY3hQd_KqQcOKEqtVAvlzH_2HJC9v2PhZozPXg==&ch=hjqIj5i0CjMuO_TwsQtiCL4pFhSoEMKCUWTF7zgOy_yVpRCH3s6J2g==) of the country's agricultural land , 3.1% of total privately owned land.
4. My seatmate Senator Travis Hackworth sponsored and I cosponsored a bill that passed, that prohibits any unmanned aircraft system from (i) dropping any item within the boundaries of or (ii) obtaining any videographic or still image of any identifiable inmate or resident at any state or local correctional facility or juvenile correctional center without consent or authorization. A violation of this prohibition is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
5. Senator Newman sponsored and I cosponsored a transportation bill that passed and allows funds to be used for any transportation project or any transportation facility within Virginia. These funds will be awarded by the Governor in the form of grants, revolving loans, or other financing tools and equity contributions. The Governor is authorized to award grants of up to $5 million dollars. Loans are interest-free and available up to the maximum of $30 million, based on funding availability. Loan terms vary but will not exceed seven years.
6. A bill passed that I cosponsored which directs the Department of Conservation and Recreation to establish a Virginia National Guard Passport that authorizes a member of the Virginia National Guard to enter state parks without paying a parking or admission fee.
7. My Republican seatmate Travis Hackworth sponsored a bill that I cosponsored and passed that would promote opportunities for energy development in Southwest Virginia, to create jobs and economic activity consistent with the Virginia Energy Plan, and to position Southwest Virginia and the Commonwealth as a leader in energy workforce and energy technology research and development.
8. Senator Tommy Norment passed a bill that requires review and approval of plans for changes to artifacts contained within the Capitol Building. This bill requires the Joint Committee on Rules to review all plans or proposals for alterations, improvements, additions, or renovations to, or other disposition of, any monuments, statuary, artwork, or other historical artifacts contained within the Capitol Building, including within the old Senate chamber, the old hall of the House of Delegates, and the Rotunda. The bill provides that no such plan or proposal shall be implemented without approval of a majority of Senate members and a majority of House members of the Joint Committee on Rules. The bill repeals the provisions of the Code of Virginia establishing the Capitol Square Preservation Council.

While there were many good bills that died. Thankfully, with a Republican controlled House, there were many bad bills that died. All attempts to infringe on your 2nd amendment rights were defeated.
Unfortunately, we were not able to repeal a law that links Virginia vehicle emissions to that of California. We absolutely must win back the House and Senate this year so that we can repeal this horrific mandate.
Now that the legislative session is complete other than the budget and veto session, election season begins in earnest. All 140 General Assembly seats will be up for grabs in November.
Let me emphasize that we're ALL up for re-election. That's 140 seats. 100 in the House and 40 in the Senate. All seats are in newly drawn districts in which many incumbent senators will actually face off against fellow incumbents or face retirement.
When we return in 2024, the General Assembly will have received a much needed overhaul and facelift. I call it "the Great General Assembly Reset". Senators Dick Saslaw, Janet Howell and Jill Vogel are just 3 of the 40 senators who have all publicly announced retirement. Because of the newly redrawn districts, most senators will face a challenger and more retirements are expected to be announced in the coming days.
I welcome the change in Richmond. I'm looking to a fresh new start with new faces and an opportunity to win back the Virginia Senate.
Thankfully, I'm the only incumbent running in Senate District 12 which consists of Chesterfield and Colonial Heights. I've represented most of this area for almost 8 years. That said, my former Senate seatmate Glenn Sturtevant is running against me. He's a nice guy with a bad voting record. Tina Ramirez decided to run for state senate after several unsuccessful runs for Congress. That said, we are not taking anything for granted and are now running full speed ahead towards the Tuesday, June 20 primary. Please see the list below for upcoming events and volunteer opportunities. clean_body: From the Desk of Senator Chase | | | | | | == | CUT TO THE CHASE WITH SENATOR CHASE Weekly Session Newsletter Week 7 of 7 We have adjourned! | | | | | | WHAT HAPPENED THIS WEEK? | WEEK 7: GENERAL ASSEMBLY UPDATE | | | Senator Amanda Chase Senator Chase has represented Chesterfield, Colonial Heights and Amelia Counties in the Senate since first elected in 2015, almost 8 years. She grew up in Bon Air and has lived most of her life in Chesterfield, since 1979. She has been rated as one of the most conservative Senators in Virginia by the American Conservative Union and has a lifetime score of 100% with the Family Foundation, VCDL and A with the NRA. She is also a champion in the General Assembly for pushing back against vaccine and mask mandates, calling for a full investigation into the 2020 Presidential Election, parental rights in education, medical freedom, protecting gun rights and help for our veterans. | WE'VE OFFICIALLY ADJORNED THE FINAL WEEK | | | == | 2023 SESSION WEEK 7 OVERVIEW Dear Friends, The Virginia Senate officially adjourned today, Saturday, February 25 at 5pm. We have completed our work for the 2023 legislative session on all of our bills. Unfortunately, we have not fully completed our work on the budget and we will have to return for a Special Session to be called by the Governor. Today, we passed a "skinny budget," which is one of the few budgets I've supported over the course of 8 years. In my opinion, we need more "skinny budgets" with less spending and more tax cutting. As for now, all legislators are headed back home to run for re-election, until reconvene for the purposes of unfinished business on Wednesday, April 12. Now that we have adjourned, we can continue to raise money to run for re-election. Please consider making a == Between now and April 12 the Governor will review bills that have passed the General Assembly and chose to sign, veto or amend these bills. When the General Assembly returns on April 12 for "reconvene," also called the "veto" session, we will approve or reject the Governor's amendments or attempt to override any vetoes. But first, here's a quick assessment of bills that actually survived. There are not many. Almost all of the most controversial bills put forward died, due to the split assembly. Here are a few bills that did pass both the House and Senate, several of these bills I was a copatron as noted: 1. A bill passed that would allow gun owners to claim a tax rebate of up to $300 dollars for buying a firearm lockbox or somewhere to store their firearm safely. And that would go into effect in this tax year and would last five years. And again, you could claim up to $300 dollars. 2. A bill passed that was carried by Sen. == , R-Bedford, and I served as a co-sponsor, that would allow colleges and universities to access health and criminal history records of students who pose a significant threat on campus. Virginia's colleges and universities would be permitted to obtain criminal histories and health records of people seen as posing a "significant" threat on campuses . This legislation was filed in response to the November shooting at the University of Virginia that left three football players dead. 3. A bill passed from Sen. Richard Stuart, R-King George, to prohibit foreign governments from making agricultural land purchases. This is probably my favorite bill that passed this year. Under the bill, the ban would apply to foreign governments or others the U.S. Secretary of Commerce has determined "to have engaged in a long-term pattern or serious instances of conduct significantly adverse to the national security of the United States or security and safety of United States persons." The bill would impose the ban starting Jan. 1, 2023, meaning it would go into effect once it is signed, but it would not void farmland purchases made before 2023. The legislation also requires the Virginia Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services to provide a yearly report to the governor and General Assembly on the farmland owned by foreign governments. The == recognized by the U.S. includes The People's Republic of China, the Republic of Cuba, the Islamic Republic of Iran, North Korea, Russia and Venezuelan politician Nicolas Maduro. In 2021, the U.S. Department of Agriculture found foreign entities and persons held an interest in == of the country's agricultural land , 3.1% of total privately owned land. 4. My seatmate Senator Travis Hackworth sponsored and I cosponsored a bill that passed, that prohibits any unmanned aircraft system from (i) dropping any item within the boundaries of or (ii) obtaining any videographic or still image of any identifiable inmate or resident at any state or local correctional facility or juvenile correctional center without consent or authorization. A violation of this prohibition is a Class 1 misdemeanor. 5. Senator Newman sponsored and I cosponsored a transportation bill that passed and allows funds to be used for any transportation project or any transportation facility within Virginia. These funds will be awarded by the Governor in the form of grants, revolving loans, or other financing tools and equity contributions. The Governor is authorized to award grants of up to $5 million dollars. Loans are interest-free and available up to the maximum of $30 million, based on funding availability. Loan terms vary but will not exceed seven years. 6. A bill passed that I cosponsored which directs the Department of Conservation and Recreation to establish a Virginia National Guard Passport that authorizes a member of the Virginia National Guard to enter state parks without paying a parking or admission fee. 7. My Republican seatmate Travis Hackworth sponsored a bill that I cosponsored and passed that would promote opportunities for energy development in Southwest Virginia, to create jobs and economic activity consistent with the Virginia Energy Plan, and to position Southwest Virginia and the Commonwealth as a leader in energy workforce and energy technology research and development. 8. Senator Tommy Norment passed a bill that requires review and approval of plans for changes to artifacts contained within the Capitol Building. This bill requires the Joint Committee on Rules to review all plans or proposals for alterations, improvements, additions, or renovations to, or other disposition of, any monuments, statuary, artwork, or other historical artifacts contained within the Capitol Building, including within the old Senate chamber, the old hall of the House of Delegates, and the Rotunda. The bill provides that no such plan or proposal shall be implemented without approval of a majority of Senate members and a majority of House members of the Joint Committee on Rules. The bill repeals the provisions of the Code of Virginia establishing the Capitol Square Preservation Council. While there were many good bills that died. Thankfully, with a Republican controlled House, there were many bad bills that died. All attempts to infringe on your 2nd amendment rights were defeated. Unfortunately, we were not able to repeal a law that links Virginia vehicle emissions to that of California. We absolutely must win back the House and Senate this year so that we can repeal this horrific mandate. Now that the legislative session is complete other than the budget and veto session, election season begins in earnest. All 140 General Assembly seats will be up for grabs in November. Let me emphasize that we're ALL up for re-election. That's 140 seats. 100 in the House and 40 in the Senate. All seats are in newly drawn districts in which many incumbent senators will actually face off against fellow incumbents or face retirement. When we return in 2024, the General Assembly will have received a much needed overhaul and facelift. I call it "the Great General Assembly Reset". Senators Dick Saslaw, Janet Howell and Jill Vogel are just 3 of the 40 senators who have all publicly announced retirement. Because of the newly redrawn districts, most senators will face a challenger and more retirements are expected to be announced in the coming days. I welcome the change in Richmond. I'm looking to a fresh new start with new faces and an opportunity to win back the Virginia Senate. Thankfully, I'm the only incumbent running in Senate District 12 which consists of Chesterfield and Colonial Heights. I've represented most of this area for almost 8 years. That said, my former Senate seatmate Glenn Sturtevant is running against me. He's a nice guy with a bad voting record. Tina Ramirez decided to run for state senate after several unsuccessful runs for Congress. That said, we are not taking anything for granted and are now running full speed ahead towards the Tuesday, June 20 primary. Please see the list below for upcoming events and volunteer opportunities. name: Rep. Dontavius Jarrells, YDA Black Caucus Chair
subject: Every Day is Black History
body:
While today marks the end of Black History Month, it's essential to acknowledge that Black history is happening all around us. It's happening in the streets, in our classrooms, in our communities, and our own homes. Black history is not a thing of the pas | |
---
|
---
For me, every day is **Black History**. While today marks the end of Black History Month, it's essential to acknowledge that Black history is happening all around us. It's happening in the streets, in our classrooms, in our communities, and our own homes. Black history is not a thing of the past; it's an ongoing story that continues to shape our society and culture. As we take this moment to reflect on the struggles and triumphs of Black people throughout history, we must also remember that there is still much work to be done. From the cultural debate over the teaching of Black history in our schools to an unfair justice system that disproportionately affects Black communities, we must continue to draw attention to and address the systemic practices that inhibit many from reaching their full potential. To support Black lives means we support Black businesses, artists, and organizations. It means acknowledging the experiences of Black people and amplifying their voices. It means standing up against racism, discrimination, and injustice anywhere and everywhere you see it. Here’s the truth—at the heart of Black History Month is a commitment to a better future. It's a reminder that we are all responsible for shaping the world we want to live in. It's a call to action to build a society that genuinely embraces freedom, liberty, and equity for all people. So, this month and every month moving forward, let us commit ourselves to listening to Black voices, uplifting Black experiences and demonstrating in our actions that every day, Black Lives Matter. Together, I look forward to building a nation with you as good as its promise. In Solidarity , **Rep. Dontavius L. Jarrells** Chair, YDA Black Caucus

It's happening in the streets, in our classrooms, in our communities, and our own homes. Black history is not a thing of the pas | | | For me, every day is Black History. While today marks the end of Black History Month, it's essential to acknowledge that Black history is happening all around us. It's happening in the streets, in our classrooms, in our communities, and our own homes. Black history is not a thing of the past; it's an ongoing story that continues to shape our society and culture. As we take this moment to reflect on the struggles and triumphs of Black people throughout history, we must also remember that there is still much work to be done. From the cultural debate over the teaching of Black history in our schools to an unfair justice system that disproportionately affects Black communities, we must continue to draw attention to and address the systemic practices that inhibit many from reaching their full potential. To support Black lives means we support Black businesses, artists, and organizations. It means acknowledging the experiences of Black people and amplifying their voices. It means standing up against racism, discrimination, and injustice anywhere and everywhere you see it. Here’s the truth—at the heart of Black History Month is a commitment to a better future. It's a reminder that we are all responsible for shaping the world we want to live in. It's a call to action to build a society that genuinely embraces freedom, liberty, and equity for all people. So, this month and every month moving forward, let us commit ourselves to listening to Black voices, uplifting Black experiences and demonstrating in our actions that every day, Black Lives Matter. Together, I look forward to building a nation with you as good as its promise. In Solidarity , Rep. Dontavius L. subject: What does it mean to be an American in 2023?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
If you're going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding.

| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4d0de21345df4558a0adfa5e41cfa9cf&_e=1-PZKuHa0bHEWSav3Y_mTD2ass1K01iIVA1XuE5Rx2l0DXj5tQC0Gh4GEYGG_hmX9Lz4kBh2Hoi0ZTvfkrmSdDK3EmzIXNND4E0o8rGXBii3RFYitnJyDU4gTHNJtmZLPPhorZYO9weVZXUWwaobECYwgcCJL3kD4TiGyMzwU1XYO6m22YgI7JWpdH84W5CmUsgbwIGctLAjbG_spWAC3XzWGMHE7pu1i10D9NUUJyjGLSyIePXTriOkbN1wegByii-e_MfoG84scVB9dykMM2mn5Upuul_s4d7YtZ2d5UbMlQSmbHqNkiP8VyqAn7BrZmKzWnBru7vg0BPoEJIU3Z7twEjvau8RoOdwuq0j7-nTuRXn6ldstLNsHvr_9g9DBOv2ybhUZsqVotCN-gIPTw%3D%3D)
Fellow American,

I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

I might have been a skinny kid with a funny last name, but my parents taught me an important lesson: _If you are going to stand out, you might as well be outstanding._

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

During a recent episode of his podcast, “The Joe Rogan Experience,” host Joe Rogan and his guest, comedian Ryan Long, discussed the issue of gender identity and the recent cultural focus on it. Hi friend, Top election experts are saying my re-election campaign will be one of the most competitive races in the entire country, and I wanted to take a moment to explain why this fight is so important to me. In a moment, I'll ask you to contribute to my campaign’s 2023 preparation efforts – but if you don’t have time (and that’s okay!), can you please [**chip in now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59415666/394137666/-1412762645?refcode=em_fr_2023.02.28_b1_AS_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTQ5ZDhiMS05YmI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6bd72hn6sfKfMNiL9SIPQy3e4H6ppXLte5WO_wUEA-o=) I believe that change can happen in a generation if we work for it. _I know, because it happened for me._ My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. My parents couldn’t afford to send me to college, so I juggled multiple jobs – from painting homes to pouring coffee – while attending UC Berkeley. It took me seven years, but I earned that degree and it opened doors for me that I hadn't thought possible before. My daughter was born 18 years ago, and I felt in my core the same determination that drove my own parents: That there was nothing that would keep me from doing everything in my power to shape a stronger, more equitable future for Amelia and her generation. **That's why I stepped up to serve in the Oregon legislature.** As a legislator, I fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation's most progressive paid family leave bill. It took hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. **Now, I’ve brought that same determination to Congress. I'm not ready to stop fighting for Oregon families, but to stay in Congress I’ll need your help.** I’ll be honest: When I learned that election experts were already predicting our 2024 race to be highly competitive, I was worried. But then I remembered the lesson I learned from our 2022 campaign: **Together, we can do anything. I need you – my grassroots supporters – with me every step of the way.** [**So, I'm asking: Will you please chip in to my campaign?
