On top of this, higher tariffs will increase incrementally depending on how much individual foreign countries devalue their currency. They devalue their currency to take advantage of the United States, and they subsidize their industries, or otherwise engage in trade cheating and abuse. And they do it now like never before, and we had it largely stopped and it was going to be stopped completely within less than a year. As tariffs on foreign producers go up, taxes on American producers will go down and go down very substantially. And that means a lot of jobs coming in. Not only will this system end our gaping trade deficits—and they are massive right now—and bring back millions of American jobs—it will also bring trillions and trillions of dollars pouring into the U.S. Treasury from foreign countries and allow us to invest that money in American workers, American families, and American communities. This plan will be the linchpin of a new Strategic National Manufacturing Initiative, that builds on my historic success in ending NAFTA, which was a tremendous thing, a tremendous achievement, nobody thought it could be done, and we did USMCA—US-Mexico-Canada, and it was an incredible thing. But we’re also going to end other unfair trade deals, and we’ll end them quickly. In addition, as a matter of both economic and national security, I will implement a bold series of reforms to completely eliminate dependence on China in all critical areas. We will revoke China’s Most Favored Nation trade status, and adopt a 4-year plan to phase out all Chinese imports of essential goods—everything from electronics to steel to pharmaceuticals. This will include strong protections to ensure China cannot circumvent restrictions by passing goods through conduit countries—countries that don’t make a product, but all of a sudden they’re making a lot of the product, it comes right through China, right out of China, and right into our country. We will also adopt new rules to stop U.S. companies from pouring investments into China, and to stop China from buying up America, allowing all of those investments that clearly serve American interests. We’re not going to allow bad things to happen to our country anymore. And we will eliminate federal contracts for any company that outsources to China. Biden will never get the job done. He is weak on China because the corrupt Biden family has received millions and millions of dollars from entities tied to the Chinese Communist Party. Everybody knows that. They try and hide it, and the Fake News doesn’t want to talk about it. Biden’s pro-China economic program puts America LAST, and it’s killing our country—my cutting-edge trade agenda will revitalize our economy by once again putting America FIRST. And by the way, we’ll get along very well with China. And you know what the reason is? They’ll respect us again, like they did just two years ago. We will quickly become a manufacturing powerhouse like the world has never seen before. Thank you very much. | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- We are up against the FAKE NEWS media, their Democrat Partners, and Big Tech who all want to see us FAIL. We need to do whatever it takes to get the TRUTH out. Thank you, Donald J Trump 45th President of the United States P.S. Text TRUMP to 88022 to receive direct updates from yours truly. I'll be sending a text soon, so don't wait. Paid for by Trump Save America Joint Fundraising Committee, a joint fundraising committee composed of and authorized by Donald J. Trump for President 2024 and Save America PAC. donaldjtrump.com |

subject: IL GOP to School Board Candidates: "We Can't Help You"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” printed across the top
body:
Chair Don Tracy touts being an infrastructure organization, but when school board candidates ask for help, they are ignored.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/f960705234c4/il-gop-to-school-board-candidates-we-cant-help-you?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.goldentreewealth.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"We Can't Help You:" IL GOP Leaders Abandon Conservative School Board Candidates While Pritzker Goes on the Attack and Funds Their Opponents" (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/we-cant-help-you-il-gop-leaders-abandon-conservative-school-board-candidates-while-pritzker-goes-on-the-attack-and-funds-their-opponents.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

During the 2022 Illinois Republican Primary, IL GOP leaders played favorites with their preferred list of so-called “establishment” candidates – even funding mailers (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-weaponized-postage-discount-to-attack-conservative-candidates-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that viciously attacked their conservative grassroots opponents.

And in exclusive audio (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/exclusive-audio-don-tracy-admits-irvin-campaign-used-il-gop-postage-discount-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) obtained by Illinois Review, IL GOP chairman Don Tracy, during a meeting with conservative leaders in July, admits that the Richard Irvin campaign for governor was allowed to use the IL GOP postage discount for mailers – a perk not afforded to other candidates in the governor’s race.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/we-cant-help-you-il-gop-leaders-abandon-conservative-school-board-candidates-while-pritzker-goes-on-the-attack-and-funds-their-opponents.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The IL GOP honors former candidate for governor Richard Irvin (standing) during their lavish luncheon on Feb. 16, 2023. (Facebook/Illinois Republican Party)

But when it comes to supporting conservative school board candidates who are running in the upcoming April 4th election, the IL GOP is silent – despite messages from candidates to Republican leaders asking for help in the form of infrastructure support, walk lists and voter data.

And candidates have confirmed that IL GOP leaders replied to emails asking for help with messages that included,

“Sorry, we can’t help you.”
https://youtu.be/OBlbpAljYkU?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
School board candidates join “Mark My Words” on AM 560 The Answer and discuss the help they need from the IL GOP.

Meanwhile, Gov. JB Pritzker, D, is publicly attacking conservative grassroots organizations that recruit and support local school board candidates, calling them “racists” and “anti-LGBTQ” among other things.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FPkUhtMAs0&t=2s&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Gov. Pritzker attacks conservative grassroots organizations and school board candidates during a recent press conference in Chicago.

Gov. Pritzker is even directing funding to support Democratic school board candidates across the state, while IL GOP leaders have all but abandoned the conservative ones.

IL GOP chairman Don Tracy argues that the party does not have the funding to support local school board candidates because the focus is on funding the party’s “infrastructure” – whatever that means – even writing in Friday’s Chairman’s Memo that,

“This, of course, is a tough love way of saying that the State Party is not able to finance the campaigns of the thousands of great Illinois Republicans that run for office in both partisan races like last November and non-partisan races like this Spring in which the candidates do not run under a party banner.”

But Tracy and the party didn’t have a problem financing mailers that attacked conservative candidates during the primary – with the words “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” printed across the top.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/we-cant-help-you-il-gop-leaders-abandon-conservative-school-board-candidates-while-pritzker-goes-on-the-attack-and-funds-their-opponents.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
During the 2022 Illinois Republican Primary, the IL GOP financed mailers attacking conservative grassroots candidates that were running against their preferred slate of establishment-backed candidates.

And Tracy and the party didn’t have a problem financing a lavish downtown Chicago (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/don-tracy-and-the-il-gop-turn-the-ari-fleischer-luncheon-into-a-richard-irvin-campaign-reunion-with-irvin-eying-a-us-senate-run.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) luncheon featuring former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/don-tracy-and-the-il-gop-turn-the-ari-fleischer-luncheon-into-a-richard-irvin-campaign-reunion-with-irvin-eying-a-us-senate-run.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
(Facebook/Illinois Republican Party)

And they certainly didn’t have a problem financing the salary of IL GOP general counsel John Fogarty, who at the same time, served as the general counsel for Irvin’s campaign for governor during the primary.

And while the IL GOP brags about the measly
$2.2 million (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-treasurer-to-grassroots-during-meeting-if-you-havent-donated-then-why-are-you-here.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) they raised over the last two years, not one penny was spent in support of conservative candidates.

The IL GOP is obsessed with money, and they heap praise on their donors, yet they don’t even support what really matters in elections — and that’s strong, conservative grassroots candidates who can win elections.

Just a few weeks ago, Illinois State Sen. Celina Villanueva, D, introduced
legislation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/breaking-il-democratic-state-senator-introduces-bill-to-allow-illegal-aliens-to-vote-in-school-board-elections.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to allow illegal aliens to register to vote in Illinois school board elections.

The proposed legislation states,

“The State Board of Education shall create a voter registration affidavit that shall be the exclusive means by which a noncitizen of the United States may register to vote in school board elections.”

The legislation goes on to cite Article III Section 1 of the Illinois Constitution that school board races are considered “non-State elections” and that illegal aliens could vote in school board races because there is not a specific citizenship requirement for voting in such an election.

And where’s the IL GOP? They are silent.

Observe any flyer promoting an event featuring school board candidates, or an event talking about school board issues – and you won’t see the IL GOP’s logo anywhere.

Why? Because they don’t care.

Ronald Reagain famously said,

“The nine most terrifying words in the english language are ‘I’m from the government and I’m here to help.’”

And here in Illinois, there’s eleven words in the english language that conservatives will never hear – and that’s,

“I’m from the Illinois Republican Party and I’m here to help.”

And it’s why Republicans can’t win elections.

And perhaps, that’s on purpose.

https://youtu.be/s14iaPtUfI4?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=72bb6e3219-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_02_28_06_36&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-72bb6e3219-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=781debfb7ca042d0a444349d6c936503&_e=vYBiwNmWfIXRwF-QThFCZ0temOZqXgkSwscUFtZ2uWvDjkervGRbArB3nwAVZFcebDWANQhW7M4rs33E2G0ImAWNf-XKaIOvLMlQNmQuQGNP4cwEbktetWdeKO2mRKazp46MfEgUqJfYMyZ5E3zltJuvlYsU0cxJpNN0R1qQt3g_LqgvWJ89W-KA-MoWzxz4el2UPpvVaHf1xMTkUXDUdFPGFkvcy4yMGHvJMnsFLejCkvnDTnsnx9eMi1mjwK2J-QjCt9UaH9YwRNThJrSGYZuuMb7nfwmFfiVjilZ3D4Iii5zZh_ZIuZ31WNX5e-Y60IOYtKYfok2ID4mYlkgehcB6ZltllpNz2caZWPJJh4kVt2K4dFZH4ChVrKyeEvHmM17PAi_VwfdPAfxe6gdB8c7kGDN0dXZGAN1z2vC_NK-vfKPvuvIkI710yYANCmdG)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=781debfb7ca042d0a444349d6c936503&_e=vYBiwNmWfIXRwF-QThFCZ0temOZqXgkSwscUFtZ2uWvDjkervGRbArB3nwAVZFcebDWANQhW7M4rs33E2G0ImAWNf-XKaIOvLMlQNmQuQGNP4cwEbktetWdeKO2mRKazp46MfEgUqJfYMyZ5E3zltJuvlYsU0cxJpNN0R1qQt3g_LqgvWJ89W-KA-MoWzxz4el2UPpvVaHf1xMTkUXDUdFPGFkvcy4yMGHvJMnsFLejCkvnDTnsnx9eMi1mjwK2J-QjCt9UaH9YwRNThJrSGYVythTUWO50gfoEHWgtnnd05NPd1KI5XiYoIbDXyj-VTUas201OQUvs3unWSLFMb0L8YpRfaNe66nAh6cOeghdY4H87tKcu_rv8rgQLGzbpaFow_UtMwwvunCMU0SPSjEjHnHXNrTBBI8CsO4Sf7JZ8Uq6RdN0X-NwMuiE_wnzZX).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

| Peter,

As I’m sure you heard from my campaign team, we’re facing our February fundraising deadline tonight at midnight.

While the 2024 election may seem far off, the investment we make in our campaign today will pay substantial dividends tomorrow. I have so much more on my to-do list while I’m in Congress, and your support ensures I can continue being our advocate.

Before tonight’s midnight fundraising deadline, will you consider contributing to our campaign? You can give using this secure link: [**_abigailspanberger.com/FebGoal_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59417259/394143361/1394218500?refcode=BLU-SPAN-20230228-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE1ODE4NmEtYTJiNy1lZDExLWE4ZTAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nn_dbHGfheerfbeCFmg-oMuVCeYrU9iMwU04Q5x5IsU=)

Both taught me that when it comes to breaking down barriers, you never give up when things get tough.

**And that's precisely what we're doing here at EMILYs List — never giving up in the fight for reproductive freedom by electing fierce women leaders at all levels of government.**

**For me, this mission is personal.** I want my daughter to grow up in a world where her reproductive rights are protected. I remember dropping her off at school the day _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned. That day, my daughter would return home less free than when I had dropped her off that morning. I was angry.

But I am also filled with hope and determination because I know we can restore and protect reproductive rights. EMILYs List is at the forefront of the fight to protect reproductive rights, and we are making progress every day. We have helped elect record numbers of women to office, and we will continue to fight until every woman has the right to make choices about her body and future.

Your support today helps ensure that children like mine across the country will inherit a world where they have more opportunities and freedoms than we do today. **That's why it's vital that we reach our $175,000 End-Of-Month goal — because we have to keep fighting for that future.**

Speaker of the House Joanna McClinton personifies everything we admire.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59418485/394149042/409185284?refcode=EM_C_230228Speaker_N_KK_90DO_3_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY1MTc1Zjg4LWE0YjctZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2iCQypYbFtzCbq3fJmhPkblQ-KJw4UesAX_xKxZL1dI=)
| Fellow activist, Today, on the last day of Black History Month, more history has been made: Pennsylvania State Representative and NPP Board Member, Joanna McClinton, has at last been elected Speaker of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives.

Today is a historic day, and Speaker of the House Joanna McClinton personifies everything we admire: hard work, dedication, empathy, compassion, fearlessness, intellect, and cooperation.

It took more than 240 years to give a woman the gavel in the Commonwealth — now a Black woman will preside over the House of Representatives at a pivotal time in the Commonwealth’s history. Representation matters. For young girls (and boys) to see a resilient and powerful woman like Joanna McClinton with the gavel in her hand is a game changer. Her newest leadership role will pay dividends for generations to come. The glass ceiling has been shattered, and the sky is the limit.

In solidarity,

Kadida Kenner
Chief Executive Officer
_The New Pennsylvania Project_ [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59418486/394149049/409185284?refcode=EM_C_230228Speaker_N_KK_90DO_3_NG_N_Signoff&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY1MTc1Zjg4LWE0YjctZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2iCQypYbFtzCbq3fJmhPkblQ-KJw4UesAX_xKxZL1dI=) | _The New Pennsylvania Project was founded in May 2021 to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate, so it reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. #
Peter, we wanted to check in and make sure you saw Pramila’s message from yesterday. **If you haven’t already, will you take 2 minutes to read Pramila’s email and consider donating toward our February End of Month goal?**
These goals allow us to set the benchmarks we need to set Pramila up for success through this cycle -- and ensure our advocacy and organizing work can continue year-round. **Your support right now will make all the difference to us, Peter.[Can you dig deep and contribute $3 -- or any amount at all -- to help Pramila?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)
If we can reach our $70,000 target for February, our campaign will be in a strong position for this cycle and Pramila won’t have to worry about fundraising as she leads the charge for reproductive justice, affordable healthcare, climate action, and workers’ rights in Congress.
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)**
Thanks for supporting Pramila through thick and thin.
-- Jayapal HQ

From: **Pramila Jayapal**
Date: Monday, February 27, 2023
Subject: The fights ahead
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
Peter,
It’s hard to believe that March is right around the corner! **We’re now hours away from our end of month deadline at 11:59pm tomorrow.**
Time is running out for us to reach our $70,000 fundraising goal. It’s critical that we build up our resources _now_ early in the cycle to be prepared for the future and all of the pivotal moments that lie ahead of us this year. The good news is, my team let me know that we’re getting close to reaching our goal -- **which means your support today is more important now than ever.**
We took a look at your supporter record, Peter -- here’s what we currently have on file for you:
**Peter's 2023 Supporter Record**
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com
**2023 Donor?:** No — not yet!**
****2022 Total:** $0
**Suggested donation:[$27](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)**

_(FYI: If you donated recently, in the mail, or with a different email address, your record might not yet reflect your contribution. Thank you for your support!)_
Support from our grassroots supporters like you allow us to continue to fight on behalf of working people and their communities every day. I am hoping that you can help us out one more time/for the first time at this crucial moment. [**Will you invest in our movement to help provide us with the resources we’ll need in the months ahead? We need to raise $70,000 by midnight tomorrow and your donation will make a real difference for us.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)**
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)**
As our progressive coalition continues to deliver for our communities, we cannot allow the far-right GOP majority to reverse **_any**_ of the hard-fought progress our movement has campaigned and delivered on.
I know there will be many more fights ahead -- because reproductive justice, affordable healthcare, climate action, voting rights, and a federal living wage cannot wait. I have been fighting tooth and nail for our communities in Congress and you have my word that will not change -- but **now I need your support today, Peter.**
[**With one day to go, can we count on you to contribute to help us close the gap and reach our $70,000 end of the month goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/39024?refcode=em20230228-2222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)
**We’re in this together, and I am beyond grateful to have your continued support,**
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20230228-2222-footer&t=25&refcode2=2222_420207_NO2FGZ&akid=2222%2E420207%2ENO2FGZ)**

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

| This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ad0215cd7584517bfee1b128caec308&_e=MGvWj2Qb4hylHc8Rqo0rFQIjaJD3JCo4VgzU2gwHIpacssTfF4P6vdYPf8NngvS0dKXZIeD_SP8wRBorwix3dxiJaHUoyyEeL_6j46W9t3QA4HZHub14McRro1MReDTdNR9BO3u6odunWphrPEt1dJMPc-MTnBObmsXzOGKdxWVhiDguQtDLht2dbK3eeYiqGJy2ykaRGdfMs-k-YLncT7JHLwCrqKJMWRYHeR1RPs3Tt3XIoOGV8tTzavjtqSkVzEzNAMckqtbc24q6-5RstlAUiweBMyr0MYnNcahjbSOAsivMRHNF8eIoTiRMMfN4URfAhHZ0bhJD6yvQD36NPJg8IaWquYhPixFtk-oWrBAiuJtlYAEDcOZT8eacbVbUfdP4CfRvRdbsUgh6gqcXCgk2GHePzvc3oFGiS45gT0OjM9sbZS_86eIiU9d5rRYB)

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ad0215cd7584517bfee1b128caec308&_e=MGvWj2Qb4hylHc8Rqo0rFQIjaJD3JCo4VgzU2gwHIpacssTfF4P6vdYPf8NngvS0dKXZIeD_SP8wRBorwix3dxiJaHUoyyEeL_6j46W9t3QA4HZHub14McRro1MReDTdNR9BO3u6odunWphrPEt1dJMPc-MTnBObmsXzOGKdxWVhiDguQtDLht2dbK3eeYiqGJy2ykaRGdfMs-k-YLncT7JHLwCrqKJMWRYHeR1RPs3Tt3XIoOGV8tTzavjtqSkVzEzNAMckqtbc24q6-5RstiTPCb0S13iNvzFHNAYoQ4jTqW0et4ohAZ15RgypqwU-I_4GjmkK-zX2w_DmF-OX806sEkl4JHbk27-TjHoXISNztG2d8O_xxmYsVZtdxF-G1XXlDwHqkMQc2QEbSVJ_ZvzwuDIYNJYynY-GtcamuUpIty0WumKibsLMaS5cv_VB)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ad0215cd7584517bfee1b128caec308&_e=MGvWj2Qb4hylHc8Rqo0rFQIjaJD3JCo4VgzU2gwHIpacssTfF4P6vdYPf8NngvS0dKXZIeD_SP8wRBorwix3dxiJaHUoyyEeL_6j46W9t3QA4HZHub14McRro1MReDTdNR9BO3u6odunWphrPEt1dJMPc-MTnBObmsXzOGKdxWVhiDguQtDLht2dbK3eeYiqGJy2ykaRGdfMs-k-YLncT7JHLwCrqKJMWRYHeR1RPs3Tt3XIoOGV8tTzavjtqSkVzEzNAMckqtbc24q6-5RstiUPM2z9UdBOR4GLq3neZ2vKbjmRfkLcAeFdzubOsysuM1wKcUR_5OxXoyQEFHgfX3a5b61IAZHXnkxpEeNAGu5QEcYDYXZZa8d33bKc7QLcWdFYlfILznKXHv4CfUm7omm7ZeXc8Lfsu7BA2dOB72TO0Ic8KeCwleNHRcHPN_Jz)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ad0215cd7584517bfee1b128caec308&_e=MGvWj2Qb4hylHc8Rqo0rFQIjaJD3JCo4VgzU2gwHIpacssTfF4P6vdYPf8NngvS0dKXZIeD_SP8wRBorwix3dxiJaHUoyyEeL_6j46W9t3QA4HZHub14McRro1MReDTdNR9BO3u6odunWphrPEt1dJMPc-MTnBObmsXzOGKdxWVhiDguQtDLht2dbK3eeYiqGJy2ykaRGdfMs-k-YLncT7JHLwCrqKJMWRYHeR1RPs3Tt3XIoOGV8tTzavjtqSkVzEzNAMckqtbc24q6-5RstrMP4jygzqrxW_kF_-k9pu3hCETaWujOKSqliAwtgCpvSIkJGSWpxRmTGq1kjy1q5A7-NFUzKPFzYujARhoqV-xYVXNa6Iiqq-H5x8DKazT9u-h3bJdwgp9mxfmNovkaXYdBVD5-SJkS_Zubdu-gjT7axhL47vcOjldwRTE6J8xM).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

They spread lies online, call us names, and stoke anger and fear — and they raise money from their millionaire donors doing it.
When we’re up against the Fox New disinformation machine, establishment politicians, and corporate interests, it can feel like David vs. Goliath.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/59420908/394157831/665036970?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230228-1-EM&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBhMjc3NTY0LWFkYjctZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0hYDCYi5CV10UOs-rnlow5tOeEoAISRjHpRHRVPTEG4=)

Can I explain something, Peter?

I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.

In fact, I’m very proud to be the only U.S. Senator who manages a full-time job outside the Senate — **as a farmer.**

Every spring, I spend weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with Republican special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

[_**That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $5 between Fight for Progress and my campaign today to help us block Mitch McConnell from taking back the Senate. clean_body: I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. | = Can I explain something, Peter? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the only U.S. Senator who manages a full-time job outside the Senate — as a farmer. Every spring, I spend weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with Republican special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. = | = Thank you so much for sticking by me. I promise to spend every ounce of time fighting for you and your families (when I’m not out in the field, of course). — Jon * | | = Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After Bernie Sanders’ 2016 presidential campaign, a few staffers decided
to continue the work to fight to elect progressives by launching Justice
Democrats. For a team with a small budget, we’ve had quite an impact in
the last few years.

We recruited AOC, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman to run and helped their
campaigns win in competitive primary elections against entrenched
incumbents. And in November, we helped Greg Casar and Summer Lee to
victory.

But here’s the unfortunate news: we’ve been facing an unprecedented
slowdown in our fundraising. And as a grassroots-funded organization, our
fundraising makes a big impact on the support we’re able to offer our
candidates.

If we don’t turn our fundraising around soon, we’ll have to consider
making budget cuts, which will impact the work that we have ahead of us.

Thank you for being a part of this movement to transform the Democratic
Party from the inside. But we need to ask for your financial support
today:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/128765?refcode=em20230228-27757&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=27757%2E1203867%2EzYJTKz ]If you’ve been waiting to make your first contribution to support our
work, this is the best time to pitch in for the first time as we solidify
our plans for this year and set our budget. Will you make a contribution?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/128765?refcode=em20230228-27757&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=27757%2E1203867%2EzYJTKz ]

Together we will continue to fight for progress for all of our
communities. Whether you can afford to donate today or not, we’re still so
thankful for you,
Peter.

— Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank

Is this what it’s come to? Rather than allowing a federal reinvestigation, MAGA Republicans are just going to pass off sensitive information to a known Trumped-up dogmatist to sift through?
| **Friend, I’m speechless.**

Speaker Kevin McCarthy granted conspiracy peddling political pundit Tucker Carlson exclusive access to _more than 40,000 hours_ of security footage from inside the Capitol during the Jan. 6 insurrection.

Is this what it’s come to? Rather than allowing a federal reinvestigation, MAGA Republicans are just going to pass off sensitive information to a known Trumped-up dogmatist to sift through?

**Friend, this goes beyond what any of us could have even predicted.**

Giving zealots like Tucker Carlson free reign to create and foster conspiracies is not only unprecedented, but completely dangerous. This just goes to show far McCarthy will go to pander to election deniers, literal _insurrectionists._

McCarthy, my colleagues, and I all have a duty to find the truth about who was there, who incited the insurrectionists, and how we can make sure that our democracy never again faces that same threat.

This latest stunt has only emboldened me even more to demand truth and justice, not whatever is filtered through the mouths of conspiracy theorists. We have to do everything we can to defeat them. Luckily, we have momentum, but we have to keep it up because the race for the majority is neck-and-neck, and every dollar counts. Fellow American,

As a successful business entrepreneur, I can tell you firsthand from experience - the most successful business ventures are those that disrupt their industry's status quo.

It's this approach that helped me launch several multi-billion-dollar companies.

When I decided to speak out against wokeness in corporate culture, I disrupted the status quo. subject: IT'S HERE: LCV's 2022 National Environmental Scorecard
body:
2022 LCV _Scorecard_ is live! |
---

** **
| **The _2022 National Environmental Scorecard_ is Here!**
Exciting news, Peter! Today, LCV released our _2022 National Environmental Scorecard_ , and **we wanted to make sure you were among the first to see it.**

Since 1970, the _Scorecard_ has been the gold standard for evaluating the environmental records of members of Congress and holding leaders accountable to their constituents. This year's publication is now available for download [here](https://links.messages.lcv.), and online at [scorecard.lcv.org](https://links.messages.lcv.).
[](https://links.messages.lcv.)
**With the passage of the landmark Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) -- the most significant federal climate legislation in our nation's history -- 2022 was a historic year for climate action.**

LCV's _2022 National Environmental Scorecard_ highlights this monumental win -- and you can now see how your representatives voted on this landmark legislation by clicking [here](https://links.messages.lcv.).

Because of the clean energy plan's importance and scope, LCV took the rare step of double scoring the vote -- an effort to hold our nation's leaders accountable for creating a healthy, sustainable, and equitable climate future for all.

In addition to the IRA, the _2022_ _Scorecard_ includes dozens of votes on other impactful climate and environmental policies, as well as votes in both chambers on legislation that would strengthen democracy and safeguard equity. For the first time this year, the _Scorecard_ includes a section highlighting the leadership of Champions of Color, including the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus, Congressional Black Caucus, and Congressional Hispanic Caucus.

In the Senate, Democratic leadership scored an average **97%** , and Republican leadership scored an average **6%** on the _2022 Scorecard_. In the House, Democratic leadership scored an average of **96%** and Republican leadership scored an average **4%** on the _2022 Scorecard_.

The votes that Congressional leaders take impact the health, safety, and sustainability of our communities and our planet -- and clearly voters know the score, too. Even though anti-environment leadership took narrow control of the U.S. House this year, the lack of a predicted "red wave" in the 2022 midterms was a testament to the hard-won progress pro-environment members of Congress enacted last year.

**Legislation passed in 2022 will continue to offer a path forward to advance climate solutions, environmental justice, peaceful presidential transitions, and jobs nationwide, providing communities with the investments needed to build an equitable and prosperous clean energy future for all.**

[Check out the _2022 National Environmental Scorecard_ here, and learn more about how your representatives and others across the country voted on the Inflation Reduction Act, democracy, and other critical issues.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/WabwQxdx_4HV/NDlQR1FLRjNZYmJLZkRhZWNWeTQ4bFQ4OGZQb25sQTEzSzBiazRETXNQdmpuVVVDaUxFMmtUUFBzQk55WElnN1E3bGxyVkxXdHlqaFI4Q0d5ZUc5bFErMXhSWmlIQ09GNVVRY3U2WWx0ams9S0/YmJMeENmV0FhYXZGWFhsK0c2VWcrTFlwV1JoNk1PTUdYOHQxOEZFTnZRWHBQcWVZNUphYllZbHkxYzNEZ05BZGVac21LWUp6djVja3RhcjVjNXEzRHFCUkl4cU93ZXIxS0)

Thank you, Peter, for your support in ensuring we hold our leaders accountable.

Onward,

Matthew Davis
Senior Director of Government Affairs
League of Conservation Voters

P.S. Want to help LCV continue this important work? [Chip in a special _Scorecard_ gift today »](https://links.messages.lcv.) |

name: Ro Khanna
subject: It's time to make our railways safer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
The failure to properly regulate rail companies had disastrous consequences on the lives of Americans and the environment.
#
Friend,
The lesson from East Palestine, Ohio is clear: the failure to properly regulate rail companies had disastrous consequences on the lives of Americans and the environment.
That’s why Representative Chris Deluzio and I have introduced the DERAIL Act, legislation that would broaden the definition of a “high-hazard flammable train” to enforce higher safety standards on our nation’s railways.
[**Sign the petition: Tell Congress to pass the DERAIL Act.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/sign/derail-act-petition/?t=1&akid=2629%2E946728%2E6FuupS)

[](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11295?t=2&akid=2629%2E946728%2E6FuupS)
The rail industry has fought to keep lax regulations that put workers and communities at risk of toxic exposure and long-term ecological damage. Norfolk Southern, the company which owned the train that derailed in East Palestine, was found just three months ago [lobbying to resist legislation requiring trains to have at least two crew members](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11296?t=3&akid=2629%2E946728%2E6FuupS) to address emergencies.
Companies like Norfolk Southern have been allowed to cut corners to rake in profits, and we’re witnessing the results. Congress has a responsibility to protect Americans feeling abandoned and invisible in the wake of this harm and hold these companies accountable by strengthening our nation’s rail safety standards.
[**Sign if you agree: It’s time to make our railways safer.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/sign/derail-act-petition/?t=4&akid=2629%2E946728%2E6FuupS)
Onward,
Ro

body:
# [ ](https://lateefahforbart.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=df04e65f592daac98a815c1f1&id=1b965f136e&e=4181cc0be9)
Friend, I have exciting news to share:
**I 'm officially running for Congress in California's 12th District!**
I'm going to tell you a bit more about me and why I'm running in a moment. First, though -- I'm committed to running a grassroots, people-powered campaign. **That means, in order to win, I 'm going to need your help.**
[**_Will you become a Founding Donor to my campaign today? We need to raise as much as we can in our first 24 hours to hit the ground running and reach voters all across this district._**](https://lateefahforbart.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=df04e65f592daac98a815c1f1&id=7fcc5c18dd&e=4181cc0be9)
**[Donate»](https://lateefahforbart.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=df04e65f592daac98a815c1f1&id=27412d725a&e=4181cc0be9)**
---
I'm running for Congress because I want to fight a system that works to silence the voiceless and keep them in the dark.
I'm going to fight for those who can't gather the strength to fight the powerful interests in Washington.
When I was young, I went in and out of high school. I became part of a juvenile system that is pretty broken for people who look like me: young women of color, young people on the streets, and victims of human trafficking, cycling in and out of incarceration.
**What did I do? I decided to fight the system - and fight for my community.**
At 16, I began my career of advocacy as an outreach coordinator for the Young Women's Freedom Center. A few years later, I would be running the Center as a young mom -- and in 2003, I was named a MacArthur Fellow for my work.
At age 18, I gave birth to my eldest daughter, Aminah -- and I quickly learned as a young single mother that the government wasn't working for people like me.
I was later chosen by then-San Francisco District Attorney Kamala Harris to lead the first-of-its-kind anti-recidivism initiative for young adults charged with low-level offenses.
On Father's Day in 2014, I lost my husband -- the love of my life -- to cancer. Even with insurance, the hospital bills left our family nearly a million dollars in debt. Thankfully, my community rallied around our family, helping us with rent and groceries, lifting us up and pushing us forward even in the darkest of times.
**I wanted to give back to the community who had done so much for us.** So, in 2016, I ran for (and won!) local office -- a transportation board seat representing the sole Black-majority district.
Along the way, I unfairly lost my board seat to bureaucratic rules -- but I got it back by doing what I do best: **fighting an unjust system.**
**And that 's what I'm going to do in Congress.** I'm going to keep fighting for the voiceless and against the powerful special interests in Washington.
**But I can 't do it alone.** In order to run a strong campaign, we need to build as much support as we can as early as we can. [**_Will you pitch in today by making a gift and becoming a Founding Donor to our campaign?_**](https://lateefahforbart.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=df04e65f592daac98a815c1f1&id=c085caa608&e=4181cc0be9)
Thank you,
Lateefah Simon
**[Donate»](https://lateefahforbart.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=df04e65f592daac98a815c1f1&id=4650d1c08c&e=4181cc0be9)**

name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: we're short of our end-of-month goal. can I count on your urgent support today?
body:
Now more than ever, I need your support.
| | |
---
Hi Derek,

**Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is today, and my team and I are having a disagreement. I think we reached our fundraising goal. My campaign manager thinks we haven’t.**
**Have you noticed that we’re sending fewer emails than we used to? That might mean happier inboxes, but it’s also a big risk that could result in us raising less for the campaign.** I’m doing everything I can to have the resources to win while also helping other Democrats do the same. We have SO much to be proud of from the last two years. Let’s secure a Democratic majority and do it again. Let’s finish the job.
What are the stakes? With House GOP hard-liners extracting a series of concessions from Speaker Kevin McCarthy, that means even the most basic but essential functions of Congress – like passing a budget and raising the debt ceiling limit to help our economy – will be challenging to achieve.
When you elected me as your representative, I hit the ground running, passing legislation that is good for our community – from protecting families' right to choose to delivering infrastructure investments to PA-06. I will continue to fight my heart out for you and your family.

**But today, we face an uphill battle.** Our families and communities face crises on all fronts, and there's too much at stake to let the GOP enact its extremist and destructive agenda.******Now more than ever, I need your support.**
**[Derek, can I count on you to stand with me in this critical fight and help us reach our critical goal of 100 Founding Members before today's midnight deadline? Donate $5 or whatever you can.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/59426704/394176561/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk792-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDBmOTdkMC1iZmI3LWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V3XzuXEMCPnJR-82j4dV_JXenlNDP5n29zNQrVOIf9E=)**

clean_body: The DNC’s fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. They’re building for 2023 and beyond and counting on our support to make critical investments while it’s still early. | | Derek, If you took one thing from my State of the Union address earlier this month, I hope it’s this: We’ve made a lot of progress together in these past two years, but we’re not finished by any stretch of the imagination. It’s time to finish the job, which means electing more Democrats across the country. One of the most powerful ways you can help make that happen is by supporting the Democratic National Committee ahead of tonight’s fundraising deadline. The DNC supports the resources that Democrats running up and down the ticket are relying on to win in the coming years. A grassroots donation of just a few bucks has so much value and importance in what it can do to support Democrats nationwide. If you can, I hope you’ll support our party by donating $7 to the DNC before tonight’s deadline. We’ve got a long road ahead to finish the job of building a better America, but I’ve seen firsthand what the American people can do when we work together. Derek, your early support will ensure Democrats have what they need to win races in every corner of our country. And that’s exactly how we can keep delivering for families nationwide.
